eph-ws01-ex01.source: EPH WS01 Example 1 · [HKDSE 2021 Paper 1 Q3] (3 marks)

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 認清題目要什麼

steps.zh: 題目要求因式分解 (Factorize)。(a) 部為二次三項式，使用十字相乘法 (Cross-method)；(b) 部由四項組成。香港文憑試卷一的固定命題邏輯為「(b) 部必須套用 (a) 部的結論」（題目常附帶指引詞 Hence / 由此）。切勿把 (b) 部由頭展開重做，而 (a) 部一定要先做對，才能取得後續的方法分 (M mark)。
steps.en: The question says Factorize. Part (a) is a quadratic trinomial, so use the cross-method; part (b) has four terms. In HKDSE Paper 1 the wording is almost always “(b) uses the result of (a)” (look for Hence). Do not expand (b) again from scratch — and (a) must be right first, or the method mark that follows is lost.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · (a) 十字相乘

steps.zh: 首項 $15x^{2}$ 拆成 $3x\cdot 5x$，末項 $-2y^{2}$ 拆成 $(-y)\cdot(+2y)$。交叉相乘檢查中間項：$(3x)(+2y)+(-y)(5x)=6xy-5xy=xy$，與題目的 $+xy$ 相符，所以分解正確。這一步是 A 分，答案寫對就有分。
steps.en: Split the leading term $15x^{2}$ into $3x\cdot 5x$ and the last term $-2y^{2}$ into $(-y)\cdot(+2y)$. Cross-check the middle term: $(3x)(+2y)+(-y)(5x)=6xy-5xy=xy$, which matches the given $+xy$, so the factorization is correct. This is the A mark — writing the right answer earns it.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · (b) 先分組，加括號

steps.zh: 四項要用併項分組。看見後三項 $-15x^{2}-xy+2y^{2}$ 的係數符號剛好與 (a) 完全相反。把負號抽出並加括號時，括號內每一項都要同時變號：$-15x^{2}$ 變 $+15x^{2}$、$-xy$ 變 $+xy$、$+2y^{2}$ 變 $-2y^{2}$，即 $-(15x^{2}+xy-2y^{2})$。這一步是卷一必考位，漏變號就無法套用 (a) 的結果。
steps.en: Four terms mean grouping. Notice that the last three terms $-15x^{2}-xy+2y^{2}$ have exactly the opposite signs of the expression in (a). When you take out a minus sign and put in brackets, every term inside changes sign: $-15x^{2}\to+15x^{2}$, $-xy\to+xy$, $+2y^{2}\to-2y^{2}$, giving $-(15x^{2}+xy-2y^{2})$. This is a Paper 1 standard step; miss the sign change and you cannot use (a).

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 用 (a) 的結果

steps.zh: 兩邊各自抽公因式：$9x-3y=3(3x-y)$；括號內再用 (a) 的答案 $15x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}=(3x-y)(5x+2y)$。這一步「用上一部的結果」就是 M 分。
steps.en: Take out the common factor of each piece: $9x-3y=3(3x-y)$; inside the bracket use the answer of (a), $15x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}=(3x-y)(5x+2y)$. Using the previous part here is exactly the M mark.

title.zh: 第 5 步 · 抽出共同括號，再拆中括號
title.en: Step 5 · Factor out the common bracket, then remove the square brackets

steps.zh: 抽出共同括號 $(3x-y)$ 之後，餘下的部分先用中括號整組包住：$[3-(5x+2y)]$。中括號前的減號必須逐項分配：$-(+5x)=-5x$、$-(+2y)=-2y$。寫的時候一定要把中括號這一步寫出來，靠心算跳步是最常見的失分位（很多同學會寫成 $3-5x+2y$）。
steps.en: After factorizing out $(3x-y)$, keep the remainder inside square brackets: $[3-(5x+2y)]$. The minus in front must be distributed to every term: $-(+5x)=-5x$ and $-(+2y)=-2y$. Always write the square-bracket step down — doing it in your head is the classic way to write $3-5x+2y$.

tip.zh: 卷一的因式分解題幾乎都是「(a) 先分一個，(b) 再用 (a)」。(b) 見到四項，先想「哪幾項是 (a) 的式子」，把它們用括號包起來，題目就通了。
tip.en: Paper 1 factorisation questions are almost always “(a) factorize one expression, (b) use (a)”. In (b), when you see four terms, ask which of them are the expression from (a), bracket them, and the question opens up.

name.zh: 計算機保底：Formula 01 求根反推因式
name.en: Calculator safety net: roots by Formula 01, then read off the factors

alt.zh: 把 $y$ 當作 $1$，$15x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$ 就變成 $15x^{2}+x-2$。用 DSE 准用計算機（Casio fx-50FH II：按 FMLA 01）輸入 $a=15$、$b=1$、$c=-2$，得兩根 $x=\frac{1}{3}$ 與 $x=-\frac{2}{5}$。由根反推因式：$x=\frac{1}{3}\Rightarrow(3x-1)$、$x=-\frac{2}{5}\Rightarrow(5x+2)$，即 $(3x-1)(5x+2)$；最後把 $y$ 補回每個 $x$ 後面：$(3x-y)(5x+2y)$。（口訣：分母移給 $x$、分子變號 —— 根 $x=\frac{p}{q}$ 對應因式 $(qx-p)$。）
alt.en: Treat $y$ as $1$, so $15x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$ becomes $15x^{2}+x-2$. On a DSE-approved calculator (Casio fx-50FH II: press FMLA 01) enter $a=15$, $b=1$, $c=-2$ to get $x=\frac{1}{3}$ and $x=-\frac{2}{5}$. Turn each root into a factor: $x=\frac{1}{3}\Rightarrow(3x-1)$ and $x=-\frac{2}{5}\Rightarrow(5x+2)$, i.e. $(3x-1)(5x+2)$. Finally put $y$ back after each $x$: $(3x-y)(5x+2y)$. Rule of thumb: the denominator moves to $x$, the numerator changes sign.

eph-ws01-ex02.source: EPH WS01 Example 2 · [HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q4] (4 marks)

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 認清題目要什麼

steps.zh: (a) 部為二次三項式，經檢驗符合完全平方 (Perfect Square) 恆等式；(b) 部包含 $(5c+d)^{2}$ 減去三項多項式。根據文憑試常見題型，必須把後三項抽負號分組，轉化為 (a) 部的結果，再進一步利用平方差 (Difference of Two Squares) 完成徹底分解。
steps.en: Part (a) is a quadratic trinomial that fits the perfect-square identity; part (b) is $(5c+d)^{2}$ minus a three-term polynomial. As usual, take a minus sign out of the last three terms and bracket them so that the result of (a) appears; then finish with the difference of two squares.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · (a) 用完全平方

steps.en: Leading term $16c^{2}=(4c)^{2}$, last term $1=1^{2}$, middle term $-8c=-2(4c)(1)$ — exactly $a^{2}-2ab+b^{2}=(a-b)^{2}$, so the answer is $(4c-1)^{2}$. This is the A mark.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · (b) 先把後三項包起來

steps.en: Taking a minus sign out of the last three terms $-16c^{2}+8c-1$ gives $-(16c^{2}-8c+1)$. Every term inside changes sign: $-16c^{2}\to16c^{2}$, $+8c\to-8c$, $-1\to+1$.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 用 (a) 化成平方減平方

steps.zh: 括號內正是 (a) 的式子，代入 (a) 的答案：$16c^{2}-8c+1=(4c-1)^{2}$。現在整題變成「平方減平方」，可以用平方差。這一步「用上一部結果」是 M 分。
steps.en: The bracket is exactly the expression in (a), so substitute $16c^{2}-8c+1=(4c-1)^{2}$. The expression is now square minus square, ready for the difference of two squares. Using the previous part is the M mark.

title.zh: 第 5 步 · 用平方差恆等式

steps.zh: 套用 $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$，其中 $a=5c+d$、$b=4c-1$。這裡減號的括號最易錯：$(5c+d)-(4c-1)$ 不能漏掉括號，否則 $-(-1)$ 會變成 $-1$。這一步是 M 分。
steps.en: Apply $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$ with $a=5c+d$ and $b=4c-1$. The bracket after the minus sign is the classic trap: $(5c+d)-(4c-1)$ must keep its brackets, otherwise $-(-1)$ becomes $-1$.

title.zh: 第 6 步 · 逐項分配負號後化簡
title.en: Step 6 · Distribute the minus to each term, then simplify

steps.zh: 把兩個中括號拆開：第一個 $(5c+d)+(4c-1)$ 直接去括號；第二個 $(5c+d)-(4c-1)$ 前面的減號要逐項分配 —— $-(+4c)=-4c$、$-(-1)=+1$，所以是 $5c+d-4c+1$（不是 $5c+d-4c-1$）。合併同類項後得 $(9c+d-1)(c+d+1)$。
steps.en: Open both brackets: the first, $(5c+d)+(4c-1)$, can be written straight away; in the second, $(5c+d)-(4c-1)$, the minus must be distributed to each term — $-(+4c)=-4c$ and $-(-1)=+1$, giving $5c+d-4c+1$ (not $5c+d-4c-1$). Collecting terms gives $(9c+d-1)(c+d+1)$.

tip.zh: 見到「$(5c+d)^{2}$ 減去一堆」，先想「後面那堆能不能變成一個平方」。把 (a) 的答案代進去之後，題目就由「四項分組」變成「平方差」，這是卷一最常見的兩步設計。
tip.en: When you see $(5c+d)^{2}$ minus a pile of terms, ask whether that pile can be turned into a square. After substituting the answer of (a), “four terms to group” becomes “difference of two squares” — the most common two-step design in Paper 1.

name.zh: 另解：完全展開後重新分組

alt.zh: 若看不出後三項是完全平方，可把 $(5c+d)^{2}$ 展開：$25c^{2}+10cd+d^{2}-16c^{2}+8c-1=9c^{2}+10cd+d^{2}+8c-1$，再做十字相乘得 $(9c+d-1)(c+d+1)$。這條路一定行得通，但要處理 $9c^{2}$、$10cd$、$d^{2}$ 三項，運算量多一倍；考試時建議優先用平方差。
alt.en: If the perfect square is hard to spot, expand $(5c+d)^{2}$: $25c^{2}+10cd+d^{2}-16c^{2}+8c-1=9c^{2}+10cd+d^{2}+8c-1$, then factor by the cross-method to get $(9c+d-1)(c+d+1)$. It always works, but you then handle three terms ($9c^{2}$, $10cd$, $d^{2}$), so the difference of two squares is the faster exam route.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 找係數的公因式

steps.zh: 係數 $6$ 和 $12$ 的最大公因數是 $6$，所以每一項都先抽走 $6$。字母方面，$m$ 只在第一項有，$n$ 只在第二項有，所以沒有共同的字母可以抽。
steps.en: The HCF of the coefficients 6 and 12 is 6, so take 6 out of every term. As for the letters, $m$ appears only in the first term and $n$ only in the second, so there is no common letter to take out.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 寫成因式相乘

steps.zh: $6m$ 抽走 $6$ 剩 $m$，$12n$ 抽走 $6$ 剩 $2n$，合起來是 $6(m+2n)$。答案是 B。展開檢查：$6(m+2n)=6m+12n$，回到原式。
steps.en: $6m$ leaves $m$ and $12n$ leaves $2n$ after taking out 6, giving $6(m+2n)$. The answer is B. Check by expanding: $6(m+2n)=6m+12n$, back to the original.

traps.zh: $6(m+12n)$ 是第二項忘記除以 $6$：$12n\div 6=2n$，不是 $12n$。抽公因式時每一項都要除。
traps.en: $6(m+12n)$ forgets to divide the second term by 6: $12n\div 6=2n$, not $12n$. Every term must be divided when a common factor is taken out.

traps.zh: $3(2m+4n)$ 只抽了 $3$，括號內的 $2m+4n$ 還有公因式 $2$，未徹底分解（題目要求 factorize completely）。
traps.en: $3(2m+4n)$ only takes out 3, but $2m+4n$ still has the common factor 2 — the question says factorize completely.

traps.zh: $6m(1+2n)$ 抽了 $6m$，但第二項 $12n$ 根本沒有 $m$，所以 $m$ 不是公因式。展開會變成 $6m+12mn$。
traps.en: $6m(1+2n)$ takes out $6m$, but the second term $12n$ contains no $m$ at all, so $m$ is not a common factor. Expanding gives $6m+12mn$.

tip.zh: 先抽係數的最大公因數，再看字母是否各項都有。抽完把答案展開檢查，是最穩的習慣。
tip.en: Take out the HCF of the coefficients first, then check which letters appear in every term. Expanding your answer to check is the safest habit.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 負號也一起抽
title.en: Step 1 · Take out the minus sign too

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $r^{2}$（$-r^{3}=-r^{2}\cdot r$、$-r^{2}s=-r^{2}\cdot s$），而且兩項都是負號，所以把 $-r^{2}$ 一次抽走最安全。
steps.en: Both terms contain $r^{2}$ ($-r^{3}=-r^{2}\cdot r$ and $-r^{2}s=-r^{2}\cdot s$), and both are negative, so factorizing out $-r^{2}$ in a single step is the safest move.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 寫成因式相乘

steps.zh: 抽走 $-r^{2}$ 之後括號內是 $r+s$（兩項都變成正）。答案是 C。展開檢查：$-r^{2}(r+s)=-r^{3}-r^{2}s$，與原式相同。
steps.en: After taking out $-r^{2}$ the bracket is $r+s$ (both terms become positive). The answer is C. Check: $-r^{2}(r+s)=-r^{3}-r^{2}s$, the same as the original.

traps.zh: $r^{2}(r+s)$ 漏了負號：原式兩項都是負，抽出來後外面的負號不可以消失。
traps.en: $r^{2}(r+s)$ loses the minus sign: both original terms are negative, so the minus outside cannot disappear.

traps.zh: $-r^{2}(r-s)$ 是抽負號時括號內沒有變號。展開會變成 $-r^{3}+r^{2}s$，第二項符號與原式不符。
traps.en: $-r^{2}(r-s)$ does not change the signs inside when the minus is taken out; expanding gives $-r^{3}+r^{2}s$, whose second term has the wrong sign.

traps.zh: $-r(r^{2}+rs)$ 只抽了 $-r$，括號內的 $r^{2}+rs$ 還有公因式 $r$，未徹底分解。
traps.en: $-r(r^{2}+rs)$ only takes out $-r$, but $r^{2}+rs$ still has the common factor $r$, so it is not fully factorized.

tip.zh: 負號開頭的式子，把負號連公因式一起抽出來；抽完括號內通常全部變正號，最易檢查。
tip.en: For an expression that starts with a minus sign, take the minus out together with the common factor; the bracket then becomes all positive, which is easiest to check.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先抽公因式
title.en: Step 1 · Take out the common factor

steps.zh: 兩項都有公因式 $2$，先抽走，括號內變成 $m^{2}-16$。抽完不要停，還要看括號內能不能再分。
steps.en: Both terms have the common factor 2; take it out and the bracket becomes $m^{2}-16$. Do not stop there — always look at the bracket again.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 括號內是平方差

steps.en: $m^{2}-16=m^{2}-4^{2}$ is a difference of two squares; by $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$ it becomes $(m+4)(m-4)$. The answer is A.

traps.zh: $2(m^{2}-16)$ 只抽了 $2$ 就停手，括號內的 $m^{2}-16$ 還可以再分——這是最常見的失分位（題目說 factorize completely）。
traps.en: $2(m^{2}-16)$ stops after taking out 2, but $m^{2}-16$ can still be factorized — the most common loss of marks (the question says factorize completely).

traps.zh: $2(m-4)^{2}$ 是完全平方，展開是 $2(m^{2}-8m+16)$，會有中間項 $-8m$，原式並沒有。
traps.en: $2(m-4)^{2}$ is a perfect square; expanding gives $2(m^{2}-8m+16)$ with a middle term $-8m$ that the original does not have.

traps.zh: $(2m+8)(m-4)$ 展開雖然等於 $2m^{2}-32$，但第一個括號 $(2m+8)$ 仍有公因式 $2$ 未抽走，未算「徹底分解」（題目要求 factorize completely）。
traps.en: $(2m+8)(m-4)$ does expand to $2m^{2}-32$, but the first bracket still has the common factor 2, so it is not factorized completely.

tip.zh: 「抽完公因式，再看一眼括號」是 DSE 的必考習慣：很多題目抽完之後，括號內還有平方差或完全平方。
tip.en: “Take out the common factor, then look at the bracket again” is a DSE habit worth keeping: many questions hide a difference of squares or a perfect square inside.

eph-ws01-w04.source: 自擬 · 平方差（係數為平方數）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 改寫成平方減平方 (Recognise Difference of Two Squares)

steps.zh: 把兩項分別改寫為完全平方：$9x^{2}=(3x)^{2}$，$25y^{2}=(5y)^{2}$。確認形態符合平方差 (Difference of Two Squares) $a^{2}-b^{2}$。
steps.en: Rewrite each term as a perfect square: $9x^{2}=(3x)^{2}$ and $25y^{2}=(5y)^{2}$. This has the form $a^{2}-b^{2}$ — the difference of two squares.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 套用恆等式 (Apply Identity)

steps.zh: 套用恆等式 $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$，其中 $a=3x$ 及 $b=5y$。因此正確答案為 C。
steps.en: Apply the identity $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$ with $a=3x$ and $b=5y$, so the answer is C.

traps.zh: $(3x-5y)^{2}$ 為完全平方 (Perfect Square)，展開後會產生中間項 $-30xy$，與題目的兩項不符。
traps.en: $(3x-5y)^{2}$ is a perfect square; expanding it produces a middle term $-30xy$, which the question does not have.

traps.zh: $(9x+5y)(x-5y)$ 展開得 $9x^{2}-40xy-25y^{2}$，是因為沒有把首項係數 $9$ 取平方根。
traps.en: $(9x+5y)(x-5y)$ expands to $9x^{2}-40xy-25y^{2}$ because the coefficient 9 was not square-rooted.

traps.zh: $(3x-25y)(3x+y)$ 沒有把末項係數 $25$ 取平方根（$25$ 的平方根是 $5$，不是 $25$）。
traps.en: $(3x-25y)(3x+y)$ does not square-root the last coefficient (the square root of 25 is 5, not 25).

tip.zh: 見到兩項而且中間是減號，先檢查兩項的係數是否完全平方數（例如 $1, 4, 9, 16, 25$）。
tip.en: When there are two terms with a minus between them, first check whether the coefficients are perfect squares (1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ...).

eph-ws01-w05.source: 自擬 · 平方差（括號減常數）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 識別括號平方減數字平方

steps.zh: 整題是「一組式子的平方」減去「數字的平方」。這裡 $a=x+3$、$b=4$。不要急著把 $(x+3)^{2}$ 展開，直接套用平方差會快很多。
steps.en: This is (a bracket)$^{2}$ minus (a number)$^{2}$, with $a=x+3$ and $b=4$. Do not expand $(x+3)^{2}$ — using the difference of squares directly is far faster.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 套用平方差並合併同類項 (Simplify)

steps.zh: 第一個括號相加得 $x+3+4=x+7$；第二個括號相減得 $x+3-4=x-1$。答案是 A。
steps.en: Adding gives $x+3+4=x+7$ in the first bracket; subtracting gives $x+3-4=x-1$ in the second. The answer is A.

traps.en: $(x-1)^{2}$ drops the “plus” bracket $(x+3+4)$.

traps.zh: $(x+7)(x-7)$ 是把第二個括號誤算成 $x-3-4$（忘記減號後的括號要整組包住再變號）。
traps.en: $(x+7)(x-7)$ mis-computes the second bracket as $x-3-4$ — remember the bracket after a minus sign must be kept whole and every term changed.

traps.zh: $(x-13)(x+19)$ 是展開時計錯，或隨意拼湊數字。
traps.en: $(x-13)(x+19)$ comes from a calculating slip or from guessing numbers.

tip.zh: 括號外的常數若是平方數（例如 $16=4^{2}$），就可以直接用 $[( )+b][( )-b]$ 迅速化簡。
tip.en: If the constant outside the bracket is a perfect square (e.g. $16=4^{2}$), you can go straight to $[( )+b][( )-b]$.

eph-ws01-w06.source: 自擬 · 十字相乘（首項係數為質數）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 十字拆解首項與末項

steps.zh: 首項 $2x^{2}$ 只能拆成 $2x$ 與 $x$；末項 $3$ 是質數，只能拆成 $1$ 與 $3$。交叉相乘檢驗：$(2x)(3)+(1)(x)=6x+x=7x$，剛好吻合中間項。
steps.en: The leading term $2x^{2}$ can only split into $2x$ and $x$; the last term 3 is prime, so it can only split into 1 and 3. Cross-checking: $(2x)(3)+(1)(x)=6x+x=7x$, which matches the middle term exactly.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 寫出因式並展開驗算

steps.zh: 展開後完全符合原式，所以答案是 B。
steps.en: Expanding gives back the original expression, so the answer is B.

traps.en: $(2x+3)(x+1)$ gives $(2x)(1)+(3)(x)=5x$ when crossed, not the required $+7x$.

traps.zh: $(x+1)(2x+7)$ 展開後末項常數是 $7$，與原式的 $3$ 不符。
traps.en: $(x+1)(2x+7)$ has a constant term of 7 when expanded, not the 3 in the question.

traps.zh: $(2x-1)(x-3)$ 展開後中間項是 $-7x$，正負號顛倒了。
traps.en: $(2x-1)(x-3)$ has middle term $-7x$ when expanded — the signs are reversed.

tip.zh: 首項與末項都是質數時，組合極少；先用較大的數字跟 $2x$ 相乘，很快就能逼近中間項的係數。
tip.en: When both the leading and the last term are prime there are very few combinations; multiply the larger number with $2x$ first to get close to the middle coefficient quickly.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 看見相同括號

steps.zh: 兩項都有同一個括號 $(a-1)$，它本身就是公因式，直接抽走，剩下的部分加進另一個括號。
steps.en: Both terms contain the same bracket $(a-1)$, so that bracket itself is the common factor: take it out and put what is left into another bracket.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 整理括號

steps.zh: 剩下的是 $b^{2}$ 與 $(a+3)$，加起來得 $b^{2}+a+3$。答案是 D。這題不用展開，看見相同括號就是「抽公因式」。
steps.en: What is left is $b^{2}$ and $(a+3)$, which add up to $b^{2}+a+3$. The answer is D. Nothing needs expanding — a repeated bracket always means “take out the common factor”.

traps.zh: $(a-1)(b^{2}+a-3)$ 是抄錯符號：題目第二個括號是 $(a+3)$，正號要保留。
traps.en: $(a-1)(b^{2}+a-3)$ copies a sign wrongly: the second bracket in the question is $(a+3)$, so the plus must stay.
$(a+1)(b^{2}+a+3)$ misreads $(a-1)$ as $(a+1)$ — a wrong common factor makes the whole answer wrong.

traps.zh: $(a-1)(b^{2}-a-3)$ 把第二個括號全部變號，但題目那部分是「加進去」，不需要變號。
traps.en: $(a-1)(b^{2}-a-3)$ changes the sign of every term in the second bracket, but that part is being added, so no sign change is needed.

tip.zh: 見到兩項有「一模一樣的括號」，直接把那括號當公因式抽走，不必先展開。
tip.en: When two terms share an identical bracket, take that bracket out as the common factor instead of expanding.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 處理次序倒轉的括號

steps.zh: 關鍵：$2y-x=-(x-2y)$。所以「減去 $(2y-x)$」等於「加上 $(x-2y)$」。括號內次序倒轉要變號，是這類題的必考位。
steps.en: Key idea: $2y-x=-(x-2y)$. So “minus $(2y-x)$” is the same as “plus $(x-2y)$”. Reversing the order inside a bracket flips its sign — a favourite exam trap.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽共同括號
title.en: Step 2 · Take out the common bracket

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $(x-2y)$：第一項抽走後剩 $(x-2y)$，第二項抽走後剩 $1$，所以是 $(x-2y)(x-2y+1)$。答案是 B。
steps.en: Both terms contain $(x-2y)$: taking it out leaves $(x-2y)$ from the first term and $1$ from the second, so the answer is $(x-2y)(x-2y+1)$ — that is B.

traps.zh: $(x-2y)(x-2y-1)$ 是把「減 $(2y-x)$」當成「減 $(x-2y)$」，負號處理錯誤。展開後常數項符號不符。
traps.en: $(x-2y)(x-2y-1)$ treats “minus $(2y-x)$” as “minus $(x-2y)$” — the minus sign is handled wrongly and the constant term has the wrong sign when expanded.

traps.zh: $(x-2y)^{2}(2y-x)$ 只是把兩項相乘，完全沒有做因式分解。
traps.en: $(x-2y)^{2}(2y-x)$ just multiplies the two terms; no factorisation has been done at all.

traps.zh: $(x+2y)(x-2y+1)$ 把第一個括號抄成 $(x+2y)$，與原式的 $(x-2y)$ 不符。
traps.en: $(x+2y)(x-2y+1)$ copies the first bracket as $(x+2y)$, which does not match $(x-2y)$.

tip.zh: 見到 $2y-x$ 與 $x-2y$ 這對「次序倒轉」的括號，記住 $2y-x=-(x-2y)$，變號後就能分組。
tip.en: When you see $2y-x$ next to $x-2y$, remember $2y-x=-(x-2y)$; after flipping the sign you can group.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 四項分兩組

steps.zh: 前兩項 $cd-4d$ 抽 $d$ 得 $d(c-4)$；後兩項 $3c-12$ 抽 $3$ 得 $3(c-4)$。分組的目標是讓兩個括號一模一樣。
steps.en: From the first pair $cd-4d$ take out $d$ to get $d(c-4)$; from the last pair $3c-12$ take out 3 to get $3(c-4)$. The aim of grouping is to make the two brackets identical.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽共同括號
title.en: Step 2 · Take out the common bracket

steps.zh: $(c-4)$ 是兩組的共同因式，抽走後剩下 $(d+3)$。答案是 A。展開檢查：$(c-4)(d+3)=cd+3c-4d-12$，與原式相同。
steps.en: $(c-4)$ is common to both groups; taking it out leaves $(d+3)$. The answer is A. Check by expanding: $(c-4)(d+3)=cd+3c-4d-12$, the same as the original.

traps.en: $(c+4)(d-3)$ gets both groups wrong: the question has $-4d$ and $+3c$, so the brackets must be $(c-4)$ and $+3$.
$(c-4)(d-3)$ does not change signs when taking out $+3$: $3c-12=3(c-4)$, so the bracket must be $(c-4)$.

traps.zh: $(c+3)(d-4)$ 分組錯誤，展開得 $cd-4c+3d-12$，中間兩項與原式不符。
traps.en: $(c+3)(d-4)$ is grouped wrongly; expanding gives $cd-4c+3d-12$, whose middle terms do not match.

tip.zh: 分組後兩個括號必須一模一樣；不一樣就換一種分法，不要硬做。
tip.en: After grouping, the two brackets must be identical. If they are not, try another grouping — do not force it.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 四項分兩組

steps.zh: 前兩項抽 $k$ 得 $k(2m-n)$；後兩項 $-14m+7n$ 是負號開頭，抽 $-7$ 得 $-7(2m-n)$（抽負號後括號內次序保持 $2m-n$）。
steps.en: From the first pair take out $k$ to get $k(2m-n)$. The last pair $-14m+7n$ starts with a minus, so take out $-7$: $-7(2m-n)$ (keep the order $2m-n$ inside the bracket).

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽共同括號
title.en: Step 2 · Take out the common bracket

steps.zh: 兩組都有 $(2m-n)$，抽走後剩 $(k-7)$。答案是 C。展開檢查：$(2m-n)(k-7)=2km-14m-kn+7n$，與原式相同。
steps.en: Both groups contain $(2m-n)$; taking it out leaves $(k-7)$. The answer is C. Check: $(2m-n)(k-7)=2km-14m-kn+7n$, the same as the original.

traps.zh: $(2m+n)(k-7)$ 的第一個括號符號錯：原式前兩項是 $2km-kn=k(2m-n)$，是減不是加。
traps.en: $(2m+n)(k-7)$ has the wrong sign in the first bracket: the first two terms give $2km-kn=k(2m-n)$ — a minus, not a plus.

traps.zh: $(2m-n)(k+7)$ 是後兩項抽 $+7$ 時沒有變號；$-14m+7n$ 抽 $+7$ 應得 $7(-2m+n)$，與第一組括號不同。
traps.en: $(2m-n)(k+7)$ does not change the signs when taking out $+7$: $-14m+7n=7(-2m+n)$, which is not the same bracket as the first group.

traps.zh: $(m-n)(2k-7)$ 公因式抽錯：第一組的公因式是 $k$ 不是 $2k$，而且 $(m-n)$ 並沒有出現在任何一組。
traps.en: $(m-n)(2k-7)$ takes out the wrong common factors — the first group's is $k$, not $2k$, and $(m-n)$ never appears.

tip.zh: 後兩項負號開頭時，抽負號出來，括號內次序跟著第一組寫（例如都寫成 $2m-n$），兩組就會一樣。
tip.en: When the last two terms start with a minus, take the minus out and write the bracket in the same order as the first group (both as $2m-n$) so that the two match.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先調位再分組

steps.zh: 把項調位，讓可以分組的排在一起：$h^{2}+ah$（都有 $h$）與 $ak+hk$（都有 $k$）。四項題不要被原本次序困住。
steps.en: Rearrange the terms so that pairs that can be grouped sit together: $h^{2}+ah$ (both contain $h$) and $ak+hk$ (both contain $k$). Do not let the original order trap you.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽公因式再抽共同括號

steps.zh: $h^{2}+ah=h(h+a)$，$ak+hk=k(a+h)$。因 $h+a=a+h$，兩組括號相同，抽出來得 $(a+h)(h+k)$。答案是 B。
steps.en: $h^{2}+ah=h(h+a)$ and $ak+hk=k(a+h)$. Since $h+a=a+h$, the two brackets are the same, so taking it out gives $(a+h)(h+k)$ — that is B.

traps.zh: $(a+h)(h-k)$ 是第二組抽 $+k$ 時變號錯誤：$ak+hk=k(a+h)$，抽 $+k$ 括號內應是 $(a+h)$ 且外面是 $+k$。
traps.en: $(a+h)(h-k)$ has a sign error when taking out $+k$: $ak+hk=k(a+h)$, so the bracket is $(a+h)$ with $+k$ outside.

traps.zh: $(a-h)(h+k)$ 把 $a+h$ 抄成 $a-h$，公因式符號錯了整題就錯。
traps.en: $(a-h)(h+k)$ copies $a+h$ as $a-h$ — a wrong sign in the common factor ruins the whole answer.

traps.zh: $(a+k)(h+k)$ 展開會出現 $k^{2}$，原式並沒有 $k^{2}$ 這一項，所以不是正確分解。
traps.en: $(a+k)(h+k)$ would expand to include a $k^{2}$ term, which the original expression does not have.

tip.zh: $h+a$ 與 $a+h$ 是同一個數。分組後括號「次序倒轉」不算失敗，直接當成相同公因式抽走。
tip.en: $h+a$ and $a+h$ are the same expression. A “reversed order” bracket after grouping is not a failure — treat it as the common factor.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 調位分組

steps.zh: 先看哪兩項有共同字母：$2x^{2}$ 與 $-xz$ 都有 $x$；$8xy$ 與 $-4yz$ 都有 $4y$。把它們排在一起。
steps.en: First look for pairs that share a letter: $2x^{2}$ and $-xz$ both contain $x$; $8xy$ and $-4yz$ both contain $4y$. Put those pairs together.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 兩組各自抽公因式

steps.zh: $2x^{2}-xz=x(2x-z)$，$8xy-4yz=4y(2x-z)$。兩組括號相同，抽出來得 $(2x-z)(x+4y)$。答案是 D。展開檢查：$(2x-z)(x+4y)=2x^{2}+8xy-xz-4yz$，與原式相同。
steps.en: $2x^{2}-xz=x(2x-z)$ and $8xy-4yz=4y(2x-z)$. The brackets match, so the answer is $(2x-z)(x+4y)$ — that is D. Check: $(2x-z)(x+4y)=2x^{2}+8xy-xz-4yz$, the same as the original.

traps.zh: $(2x+z)(x+4y)$ 第一個括號符號錯：原式有 $-xz$，所以應是 $(2x-z)$。
traps.en: $(2x+z)(x+4y)$ has the wrong sign in the first bracket: the question has $-xz$, so it must be $(2x-z)$.

traps.zh: $(2x-z)(x-4y)$ 是第二組抽 $+4y$ 時沒有變號；$8xy-4yz=4y(2x-z)$，外面是 $+4y$，括號內不變號。
traps.en: $(2x-z)(x-4y)$ does not change signs when taking out $+4y$: $8xy-4yz=4y(2x-z)$, so the bracket stays unchanged.

traps.zh: $(x-z)(2x+4y)$ 公因式抽錯：$2x^{2}-xz=x(2x-z)$，第一組的公因式是 $x$，括號內還有一個 $2$。
traps.en: $(x-z)(2x+4y)$ takes out the wrong factors: $2x^{2}-xz=x(2x-z)$, so the common factor is $x$ and a 2 remains inside the bracket.

tip.zh: 四項題先調位再分組。分組的原則是「兩組抽完後括號要一樣」，所以先試最有希望的一對。
tip.en: For four terms, rearrange first and then group. The rule is “the brackets must match after grouping”, so try the most promising pair first.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 認出平方差

steps.zh: 整題是「平方減平方」：$(5c+d)^{2}$ 減 $(3c-2)^{2}$。直接用平方差恆等式，不要展開那兩個平方（展開會多走很多步）。
steps.en: The whole expression is square minus square: $(5c+d)^{2}$ minus $(3c-2)^{2}$. Use the difference of two squares straight away — expanding those squares costs many extra steps.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 代入 $a$ 與 $b$

steps.zh: 這裡 $a=5c+d$、$b=3c-2$。平方差的兩個括號是「一加一減」。減號那個一定要加括號，因為 $-(3c-2)$ 的 $-(-2)$ 會變成 $+2$。
steps.en: Here $a=5c+d$ and $b=3c-2$. One bracket adds and one subtracts. The subtracting bracket must be bracketed, because $-(-2)$ becomes $+2$.

steps.zh: 第一個括號：$5c+d+3c-2=8c+d-2$；第二個括號：$5c+d-3c+2=2c+d+2$。答案是 A。
steps.en: First bracket: $5c+d+3c-2=8c+d-2$; second bracket: $5c+d-3c+2=2c+d+2$. The answer is A.

traps.zh: $(8c+d+2)(2c+d-2)$ 源於減號後漏加小括號：計算 $(5c+d)-(3c-2)$ 時誤寫成 $5c+d-3c-2=2c+d-2$。切記減號後的整個因式要用小括號包住，再逐項變號。
traps.en: $(8c+d+2)(2c+d-2)$ comes from dropping the brackets after the minus sign: $(5c+d)-(3c-2)$ is mis-evaluated as $5c+d-3c-2=2c+d-2$. Always bracket the whole factor after a minus sign and change every sign.

traps.zh: $(2c+d-2)(8c+d-2)$ 兩個括號的 $c$ 係數與常數配錯，展開後不會等於原式。
traps.en: $(2c+d-2)(8c+d-2)$ mismatches the $c$ coefficients and the constants; expanded it is not the original expression.

traps.zh: $(8c+d-2)^{2}$ 是把平方差當成完全平方；平方差一定是兩個不同括號相乘。
traps.en: $(8c+d-2)^{2}$ treats a difference of squares as a perfect square; a difference of squares always gives two different brackets.

tip.zh: 平方差的兩個括號只有「中間那個符號」不同（一加一減），其餘完全相同。用這個特徵可以快速檢查答案。
tip.en: The two brackets of a difference of squares differ only in the middle sign (one plus, one minus) — everything else is identical, which makes checking quick.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 檢查是否完全平方

steps.en: Leading term $9a^{2}=(3a)^{2}$, last term $1=1^{2}$, middle term $6a=2(3a)(1)$ — exactly the $a^{2}+2ab+b^{2}$ pattern, so it is a perfect square.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 寫成平方

steps.en: The middle term is positive, so use the $(a+b)^{2}$ form: $(3a+1)^{2}$. The answer is C. Check: $(3a+1)^{2}=9a^{2}+6a+1$.

traps.zh: $(3a-1)^{2}$ 展開的中間項是 $-6a$，但題目是 $+6a$，所以要用加號的版本。
traps.en: $(3a-1)^{2}$ expands with middle term $-6a$, but the question has $+6a$, so the plus version is needed.

traps.zh: $(9a+1)(a+1)$ 展開得 $9a^{2}+10a+1$，中間項是 $10a$ 不是 $6a$，十字相乘的組合不對。
traps.en: $(9a+1)(a+1)$ expands to $9a^{2}+10a+1$; the middle term is $10a$, not $6a$, so the cross-method combination is wrong.

traps.zh: $3a(3a+2)+1$ 根本沒有完成因式分解（還有「$+1$」在外面），答案必須是純粹的因式相乘。
traps.en: $3a(3a+2)+1$ is not fully factorized — there is still a “$+1$” outside; the answer must be a pure product of factors.

tip.zh: 檢查完全平方的口訣：中間項是否等於 $2 ×$（首項的平方根）$×$（尾項的平方根）。
tip.en: Quick perfect-square test: is the middle term $2\times$(square root of the first term)$\times$(square root of the last term)?

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 負號開頭，先抽 $-3$

steps.zh: 三項係數的最大公因數是 $3$，而首項是負號，所以把 $-3$ 一次抽走。抽負號時括號內每一項都要變號：$-3a^{2}$ 變 $a^{2}$、$+12a$ 變 $-4a$、$-12$ 變 $+4$。
steps.en: The HCF of the three coefficients is 3 and the leading term is negative, so factorize out $-3$ in a single step. Every term inside changes sign: $-3a^{2}\to a^{2}$, $+12a\to-4a$, $-12\to+4$.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 括號內是完全平方

traps.zh: $3(a-2)^{2}$ 漏了負號：原式首項是 $-3a^{2}$，抽出來的外面必須是 $-3$。
traps.en: $3(a-2)^{2}$ loses the minus sign: the leading term is $-3a^{2}$, so the factor outside must be $-3$.
$-3(a+2)^{2}$ has the wrong sign in the middle: $(a+2)^{2}=a^{2}+4a+4$, but the bracket is $a^{2}-4a+4$.

traps.zh: $-3(a-2)(a+2)$ 是把完全平方誤當平方差；平方差展開是 $a^{2}-4$，沒有中間項。
traps.en: $-3(a-2)(a+2)$ mistakes a perfect square for a difference of squares; the latter expands to $a^{2}-4$ with no middle term.

tip.zh: 見到所有係數都有公因式、而且首項是負號，先抽負的公因式出來，題目會立刻變簡單。
tip.en: If every coefficient has a common factor and the first term is negative, take out the negative common factor and the question becomes much easier.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 檢查是否完全平方

steps.zh: 首項是 $x^{2}$、尾項 $16y^{2}=(4y)^{2}$、中間項 $8xy=2(x)(4y)$，符合完全平方。注意尾項的平方根是 $4y$（連 $y$ 一起）。
steps.en: First term $x^{2}$, last term $16y^{2}=(4y)^{2}$, middle term $8xy=2(x)(4y)$ — a perfect square. Note that the square root of the last term is $4y$ (the $y$ comes with it).

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 寫成平方

steps.en: The middle term is positive, so use $(a+b)^{2}$: $(x+4y)^{2}$. The answer is D. Check: $(x+4y)^{2}=x^{2}+8xy+16y^{2}$.

traps.zh: $(x-4y)^{2}$ 展開的中間項是 $-8xy$，題目是 $+8xy$，符號相反。
traps.en: $(x-4y)^{2}$ expands with middle term $-8xy$, but the question has $+8xy$ — the sign is opposite.
$(x+8y)^{2}$ misreads $8xy$ as “$2\times x\times 8y$”; it should be $2\times x\times 4y$ because the last term is $16y^{2}=(4y)^{2}$.

traps.zh: $(x+4y)(x-4y)$ 是平方差，展開得 $x^{2}-16y^{2}$，沒有中間項 $8xy$。
traps.en: $(x+4y)(x-4y)$ is a difference of squares, expanding to $x^{2}-16y^{2}$ with no $8xy$ term.

tip.zh: 尾項有字母時，記得把字母也放進平方根裡：$16y^{2}$ 的平方根是 $4y$ 不是 $4$。
tip.en: When the last term contains a letter, take the letter into the square root: the square root of $16y^{2}$ is $4y$, not 4.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 十字相乘

steps.zh: 首項 $x^{2}=x × x$；末項 $-5$ 拆成 $(-5)(+1)$（一正一負）。交叉相加：$(-5)+(+1)=-4$，正好等於中間項係數 $-4$，所以這組正確。
steps.en: Leading term $x^{2}=x\times x$; the last term $-5$ splits into $(-5)(+1)$ — one negative, one positive. Now check by cross-multiplying and adding: $(-5)+(+1)=-4$, exactly the middle coefficient, so this combination is correct.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 展開檢查

steps.zh: 展開後回到原式，答案是 A。做完十字相乘一定要展開檢查，這是免費的保險。
steps.en: Expanding gives back the original expression, so the answer is A. Always check a cross-method result by expanding — it is free insurance.

traps.zh: $(x+5)(x-1)$ 展開的中間項是 $+4x$（$+5x-x$），題目是 $-4x$，正負號對調了。
traps.en: $(x+5)(x-1)$ expands with middle term $+4x$ ($+5x-x$), but the question has $-4x$ — the signs are swapped.

traps.zh: $(x-5)(x-1)$ 展開的中間項是 $-6x$，與題目的 $-4x$ 不符；末項 $-5$ 要拆成一正一負才對。
traps.en: $(x-5)(x-1)$ expands with middle term $-6x$, not $-4x$; the last term $-5$ needs one positive and one negative factor.

traps.zh: $(x+5)(x+1)$ 展開的中間項是 $+6x$，末項 $-5$ 拆成兩個正數會得到 $+5$，與題目不符。
traps.en: $(x+5)(x+1)$ expands with middle term $+6x$; two positive factors give $+5$ for the last term, which does not match.

tip.zh: 末項是負數時，兩個因式一定一正一負；交叉相加要等於中間項的係數（連符號）。
tip.en: When the last term is negative, the two factors must have opposite signs; the cross-sum must equal the middle coefficient together with its sign.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 十字相乘（首項係數不是 1）

steps.en: The leading term $2a^{2}$ splits into $2a\times a$; the last term $-12$ splits into $(-3)(+4)$. Cross-multiply: $(2a)(+4)+(-3)(a)=8a-3a=5a$, which equals the middle term, so this combination is correct.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 展開檢查

steps.zh: 展開後回到原式，答案是 C。首項係數不是 1 時，每個組合都要這樣核對一次。
steps.en: Expanding gives back the original expression, so the answer is C. When the leading coefficient is not 1, every combination has to be checked this way.

traps.zh: $(2a+3)(a-4)$ 展開的中間項是 $-5a$（$-8a+3a$），題目是 $+5a$，兩項的符號對調了。
traps.en: $(2a+3)(a-4)$ expands with middle term $-5a$ ($-8a+3a$), but the question has $+5a$ — the signs are swapped.

traps.zh: $(2a-3)(a-4)$ 展開的中間項是 $-11a$，末項會是 $+12$，與題目的 $-12$ 不符。
traps.en: $(2a-3)(a-4)$ gives middle term $-11a$ and last term $+12$, which does not match $-12$.

traps.zh: $(2a+3)(a+4)$ 展開的中間項是 $+11a$，末項是 $+12$，兩項都不符合題目。
traps.en: $(2a+3)(a+4)$ gives middle term $+11a$ and last term $+12$; neither matches the question.

tip.zh: 係數不是 1 時要多試幾個組合，方法固定：先拆首項，再拆末項，然後交叉相乘相加，看是否等於中間項。
tip.en: When the leading coefficient is not 1, try several combinations. The method is fixed: split the first term, split the last term, cross-multiply and add, then compare with the middle term.

eph-ws01-s01.source: EPH WS01 · Basic Skills Q7(b) · Factorize completely (2 marks)

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 三項、首項負數：先抽 $-1$
title.en: Step 1 · Negative leading term: take $-1$ out first

steps.zh: 整條式三項，首項是 $-4m^{2}$。第一步一律把 $-1$ 抽出來（等於每一項都變號），括號內才用恆等式。這一步是方法分，寫了才有後面的分。
steps.en: The expression has three terms and the leading term is $-4m^{2}$. Take $-1$ out first (that flips every sign), then use an identity inside the bracket. This is the method mark.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 認出完全平方

steps.en: Inside the bracket $4m^{2}=(2m)^{2}$, $25n^{2}=(5n)^{2}$ and the middle term $-20mn=-2(2m)(5n)$, which is exactly $a^{2}-2ab+b^{2}=(a-b)^{2}$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 寫成平方，記得保留負號
title.en: Step 3 · Write it as a square — keep the minus sign

steps.zh: 答案是 $-(2m-5n)^{2}$。答題時外面的負號一定要抄，漏了的話展開就變回正數。
steps.en: The answer is $-(2m-5n)^{2}$. Always copy the minus sign in front — drop it and expanding gives the wrong sign.

traps.label: 抽了 $-1$ 就停手
traps.zh: 寫成 $-(4m^{2}-20mn+25n^{2})$ 就當完成。題目要求 completely，括號內仍要分解到 $(2m-5n)^{2}$。
traps.en: Writing $-(4m^{2}-20mn+25n^{2})$ and stopping: the question says 'completely', so the bracket still has to become $(2m-5n)^{2}$.

traps.label: 中間項符號錯
traps.labelEn: Wrong sign in the middle term
traps.zh: 寫成 $(2m+5n)^{2}$：那個展開是 $+20mn$，但題目是 $-20mn$，所以必須是 $(2m-5n)^{2}$。
traps.en: Writing $(2m+5n)^{2}$: that expands to $+20mn$, but the question has $-20mn$, so it must be $(2m-5n)^{2}$.

tip.zh: 看到三項而首項是負數：先抽 $-1$。剩下的不是 $a^{2}\pm 2ab+b^{2}$ 就是十字相乘，一刀切開兩類。
tip.en: Three terms with a negative leading term: take $-1$ out first. What is left is either $a^{2}\pm 2ab+b^{2}$ or a cross-method job.

eph-ws01-s02.source: EPH WS01 · Basic Skills Q9(a) · Factorize completely (2 marks)

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 十字相乘：拆首項與末項
title.en: Step 1 · Cross-method: split the first and last terms

steps.zh: 首項 $x^{2}$ 只能拆成 $x\cdot x$；末項 $3y^{2}$ 拆成 $y\cdot 3y$（因為兩個括號都要有 $y$，展開才會有 $y^{2}$ 項）。
steps.en: The first term $x^{2}$ can only split as $x\cdot x$; the last term $3y^{2}$ splits as $y\cdot 3y$ — both brackets need a $y$, otherwise expanding never produces $y^{2}$.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 交叉相乘驗中間項

steps.zh: 交叉相乘的兩個積相加要等於題目的中間項 $+4xy$。剛剛好，代表拆對了。這一步只花幾秒，卻可以救回一分。
steps.en: The two cross products must add up to the given middle term $+4xy$. They do, so the split is right. It takes seconds and saves a mark.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 寫出答案

steps.zh: 兩個括號內都是加號：因為末項 $+3y^{2}$ 是正數、中間項 $+4xy$ 也是正數。
steps.en: Both brackets take a plus sign: the last term $+3y^{2}$ is positive and the middle term $+4xy$ is positive too.

traps.label: 兩個括號都寫減號
traps.zh: 寫成 $(x-y)(x-3y)$：那樣中間項是 $-4xy$，題目是 $+4xy$，所以兩個括號必須同號（都加）。
traps.en: Writing $(x-y)(x-3y)$ gives $-4xy$ in the middle, but the question has $+4xy$ — so both brackets must have the same sign (both plus).

traps.label: 拆完不驗算
traps.zh: 拆完 $3y^{2}=y\cdot 3y$ 就直接寫答案。中間項對不上就代表拆錯，務必做一次交叉相乘。
traps.en: Writing the answer straight after splitting $3y^{2}=y\cdot 3y$. If the middle term does not match, the split is wrong — always do the cross-check.

traps.label: 漏掉一個 $y$
traps.zh: 寫成 $(x+y)(x+3)$：第二個括號少了 $y$，展開後不會是原式。
traps.en: Writing $(x+y)(x+3)$ loses a $y$ in the second bracket; expanding it will not give the original expression.

tip.zh: 末項含 $y^{2}$ → 兩個括號都要有 $y$；中間項決定兩個符號同號還是異號（正同負異）。
tip.en: If the last term contains $y^{2}$, both brackets need a $y$. The sign of the middle term decides whether the two signs match (same when positive, opposite when negative).

eph-ws01-s03.source: EPH WS01 · Basic Skills Q9(b) · Factorize completely (2 marks)

steps.zh: 首項 $6m^{2}$ 有兩個拆法（$m\cdot 6m$ 或 $2m\cdot 3m$）。先試 $2m\cdot 3m$，因為係數小、組合較少，容易篩。
steps.en: The leading term $6m^{2}$ can split two ways ($m\cdot 6m$ or $2m\cdot 3m$). Try $2m\cdot 3m$ first — the coefficients are smaller and there are fewer cases to test.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 末項負數 → 兩個符號相反，再交叉相乘
title.en: Step 2 · Negative last term means opposite signs, then cross-check

steps.zh: $-10n^{2}$ 拆成 $(-5n)\cdot(+2n)$，因為末項是負數，兩個括號的符號一定相反。交叉相乘：$4mn-15mn=-11mn$，與題目的 $-11mn$ 相符。
steps.en: Split $-10n^{2}$ as $(-5n)\cdot(+2n)$: the last term is negative, so the two brackets must carry opposite signs. Cross-check: $4mn-15mn=-11mn$, matching the given $-11mn$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 寫出答案

steps.zh: 答案就是 $(2m-5n)(3m+2n)$。次序可以寫 $(3m+2n)(2m-5n)$，但符號要配對好，不要一個括號內同時改兩個符號。
steps.en: The answer is $(2m-5n)(3m+2n)$. Writing $(3m+2n)(2m-5n)$ is equally correct, but keep the signs paired — never flip two signs inside one bracket.

traps.label: 符號都寫成加
traps.zh: 寫成 $(2m+5n)(3m+2n)$：末項會變成 $+10n^{2}$，但題目是 $-10n^{2}$，所以其中一個括號必須是減。
traps.en: Writing $(2m+5n)(3m+2n)$ gives $+10n^{2}$ at the end, but the question has $-10n^{2}$ — one bracket must be negative.

traps.label: 首項拆成 $m\cdot 6m$ 硬做
traps.zh: 拆成 $m\cdot 6m$ 之後要試很多組才對得上 $-11mn$，浪費時間。係數先試「接近的拆法」。
traps.en: Splitting as $m\cdot 6m$ needs many trial cases before $-11mn$ works — start with the closer split $2m\cdot 3m$.

tip.zh: 十字相乘三步：拆首項 → 看末項定符號（正同負異）→ 交叉相乘驗中間項。次序固定的話，卷一只花一兩分鐘。
tip.en: Cross-method in three moves: split the first term, use the last term to fix the signs (same when positive, opposite when negative), then cross-check the middle term.

eph-ws01-s04.source: EPH WS01 · Basic Skills Q10(a) · Factorize completely (2 marks)

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 三項都有 $n$：先抽公因式
title.en: Step 1 · Every term has $n$: take out the common factor

steps.zh: 三項都含 $n$，先抽走它。抽走之後括號內只剩 $m$，變回「純數字係數」的十字相乘，處理起來容易得多。
steps.en: All three terms contain $n$, so take it out first. Inside the bracket only $m$ is left, which turns the problem back into a cross-method with plain number coefficients.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 括號內十字相乘

steps.en: Split $2m^{2}$ as $2m\cdot m$ and $-14$ as $(+7)\cdot(-2)$; cross-checking gives $(2m)(-2)+(7)(m)=-4m+7m=3m$, matching $+3m$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 把 $n$ 乘回去

steps.zh: 答案要保留外面的 $n$：$n(2m+7)(m-2)$。漏了 $n$ 就是漏了一個因式。
steps.en: Keep the $n$ in the answer: $n(2m+7)(m-2)$. Dropping it means dropping a factor.

traps.label: 忘記抽公因式 $n$
traps.zh: 直接對 $2m^{2}n+3mn-14n$ 做十字相乘：多一個字母，很容易配錯，而且答案一樣要抽 $n$。
traps.en: Running the cross-method on $2m^{2}n+3mn-14n$ directly drags an extra letter into every trial case — and the final answer still needs the $n$.

traps.label: 抽完就停手
traps.zh: 只寫 $n(2m^{2}+3m-14)$：題目要求 completely，括號內要再分解成 $(2m+7)(m-2)$。
traps.en: Writing only $n(2m^{2}+3m-14)$: the question says 'completely', so the bracket still has to become $(2m+7)(m-2)$.

tip.zh: 三項都含同一個字母 → 先抽公因式，括號內變回純係數十字相乘。這個「先抽後拆」的次序，幾乎每一年的卷一都合用。
tip.en: When every term shares a letter, take the common factor out first: inside the bracket it is a plain cross-method again. 'Factor out, then split' works almost every year.

eph-ws01-s05.source: EPH WS01 · Basic Skills Q10(b) · Factorize completely (2 marks)

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 首項負數：整條抽 $-1$
title.en: Step 1 · Negative leading term: take $-1$ out

steps.zh: 抽 $-1$ 是「每一項都變號」：$-4x^{2}\to 4x^{2}$、$+15xy\to -15xy$、$-9y^{2}\to +9y^{2}$。三個符號都要反，只改一項就錯。
steps.en: Taking out $-1$ flips every sign: $-4x^{2}\to 4x^{2}$, $+15xy\to -15xy$ and $-9y^{2}\to +9y^{2}$. All three change — changing only one is wrong.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 括號內十字相乘

steps.en: Split $4x^{2}$ as $4x\cdot x$ and $9y^{2}$ as $(-3y)\cdot(-3y)$; the cross products $(4x)(-3y)+(-3y)(x)=-12xy-3xy=-15xy$ match the given $-15xy$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 寫答案，負號要留住
title.en: Step 3 · Write the answer and keep the minus

steps.zh: 答案 $-(4x-3y)(x-3y)$。如果想把負號收進括號寫成 $(3y-4x)(x-3y)$，也是等值，但兩者只可選其一，不可以兩個都做。
steps.en: The answer is $-(4x-3y)(x-3y)$. Absorbing the minus into a bracket, giving $(3y-4x)(x-3y)$, is equally correct — but do only one of the two.

traps.label: 只改第一項的符號
traps.zh: 寫成 $-(4x^{2}+15xy-9y^{2})$：抽 $-1$ 是三個符號一齊反，漏改一項展開就會多出／少了項。
traps.en: Writing $-(4x^{2}+15xy-9y^{2})$: taking out $-1$ flips all three, and missing one makes the expansion wrong.

traps.label: 忘了把負號乘回去
traps.labelEn: Losing the minus at the end
traps.zh: 寫成 $(4x-3y)(x-3y)$：展開是 $+4x^{2}-15xy+9y^{2}$，與原式相差一個負號。
traps.en: Writing $(4x-3y)(x-3y)$ expands to $+4x^{2}-15xy+9y^{2}$ — the original expression is that with a minus sign in front.

tip.zh: 首項負數的十字相乘：抽 $-1$ → 括號內十字相乘 → 負號留在外面。三步固定，卷一只需半分鐘，是必搶的分。
tip.en: Cross-method with a negative leading term: take out $-1$, do the cross-method inside, then leave the minus outside. A fixed three-move routine worth easy Paper 1 marks.

eph-ws01b-m01.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q1 · [HKCEE 2006 Paper 2 Q4]

steps.zh: 四項又沒有全部共同的公因式 → 用分組。把 $ac$、$bc$ 放一組（有公因式 $c$），$ad$、$bd$ 放一組（有公因式 $d$）。
steps.en: Four terms and no factor common to all of them, so group. Put $ac$ and $bc$ together (common factor $c$), and $ad$, $bd$ together (common factor $d$).

steps.zh: 第一組抽 $c$ 得 $c(a-b)$；第二組抽 $d$ 得 $d(a-b)$。兩組的括號都是 $(a-b)$ —— 這就是分組成功的訊號。
steps.en: The first pair gives $c(a-b)$; the second gives $d(a-b)$. Both brackets are $(a-b)$ — the sign that the grouping worked.

steps.zh: 把 $(a-b)$ 當作一個整體抽走，剩下 $c-d$ 放進另一個括號。
steps.en: Treat $(a-b)$ as one object and take it out; what is left, $c-d$, goes into the other bracket.

traps.zh: 符號：$(a+b)$ 對不上原式首兩項 $ac-bc$（那是 $c(a-b)$，不是 $c(a+b)$）。
traps.en: Sign: $(a+b)$ cannot give $ac-bc$, which is $c(a-b)$, not $c(a+b)$.

traps.zh: 把兩組抽出來的公因式寫成 $(d-c)$：$(d-c)=-\,(c-d)$，與 $(c-d)$ 差一個負號。
traps.en: Writing $(d-c)$: note $(d-c)=-(c-d)$, so it differs from $(c-d)$ by a sign.

traps.zh: 同時抄錯兩個符號（$a+b$ 與 $d-c$）：展開後首項會變成 $+ac$ 而非 $ac-bc$。
traps.en: Two sign slips together ($a+b$ and $d-c$): expanding gives $+ac$ where the question has $ac-bc$.

tip.zh: 分組三件事：分對組 → 各自抽公因式 → 兩個括號要一模一樣。
tip.en: Grouping in three moves: split into pairs, factor each pair, and the two brackets must match exactly.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $a=2$, $b=3$, $c=5$, $d=7$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。
alt.en: Paper 2 rescue plan: put small numbers into the letters (for example $a=2$, $b=3$, $c=5$, $d=7$; avoid $0$ and $1$ because they make several options equal and useless), evaluate the question on your calculator, then substitute the same numbers into the four options — only one gives the same value, and that is the answer. It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m02.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q2 · [HKCEE 2006 Paper 2 Q4]

steps.zh: 四項沒有全部共同的公因式 → 分組。$pr$、$ps$ 一組抽 $p$；$qs$、$qr$ 一組抽 $q$。
steps.en: No factor common to all four terms, so group: $pr$, $ps$ share $p$, and $qs$, $qr$ share $q$.

steps.zh: $s+r$ 與 $r+s$ 是同一個數（加法交換律），所以兩個括號其實一樣。
steps.en: $s+r$ and $r+s$ are the same number (addition is commutative), so the two brackets are in fact identical.

steps.zh: 抽走 $(r+s)$，剩下 $p-q$。
steps.en: Take out $(r+s)$; what is left is $p-q$.

traps.zh: $(q-p)=-(p-q)$：與正確答案相差一個負號，展開後 $pr$ 的係數會變成 $-p$。
traps.en: $(q-p)=-(p-q)$: it differs from the correct answer by a sign, giving $-p$ as the coefficient of $r$.

traps.zh: 第一組的公因式是 $p$ 而不是 $r$：$pr$ 與 $ps$ 都含 $p$。
traps.en: The common factor of the first pair is $p$, not $r$: both $pr$ and $ps$ contain $p$.

traps.zh: 同時抄錯兩處（$r-s$ 與 $q-p$）：展開後 $ps$ 一項會變成 $-ps$。
traps.en: Two slips at once ($r-s$ and $q-p$): expanding gives $-ps$ instead of $+ps$.

tip.zh: 後兩項抽出來的括號次序倒轉不要緊（$s+r=r+s$），但符號要對。
tip.en: It is fine if the second bracket comes out in a different order ($s+r=r+s$), but the signs must be right.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $p=2$, $q=3$, $r=5$, $s=7$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。
alt.en: Paper 2 rescue plan: put small numbers into the letters (for example $p=2$, $q=3$, $r=5$, $s=7$; avoid $0$ and $1$ because they make several options equal and useless), evaluate the question on your calculator, then substitute the same numbers into the four options — only one gives the same value, and that is the answer. It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m03.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q3 · [HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q4]

title.zh: 認題：四項，留意共同括號
title.en: Four terms: look for a common bracket

steps.zh: 先把第一、三項（都有 $2y$）與第二、四項（都有 $z$）分開想：$2y(x+2y)$ 與 $z(x+2y)$。
steps.en: Think of the first and third terms together (both have $2y$) and the second and fourth (both have $z$): $2y(x+2y)$ and $z(x+2y)$.

steps.zh: 照位置分組：$2xy-xz=x(2y-z)$，$4y^{2}-2yz=2y(2y-z)$。兩組都是 $(2y-z)$ ✓
steps.en: Group as written: $2xy-xz=x(2y-z)$ and $4y^{2}-2yz=2y(2y-z)$. Both brackets are $(2y-z)$ ✓

steps.zh: 抽走 $(2y-z)$，剩下 $x+2y$。
steps.en: Take out $(2y-z)$; what is left is $x+2y$.

traps.en: $(x-2y)$ with $2y(2y-z)$ cannot give the $+4y^{2}$ of the question — it produces $-4y^{2}$.

traps.zh: 兩個括號都寫加號：分組時第二組是 $+4y^{2}-2yz$，抽 $2y$ 之後必然是 $(2y-z)$。
traps.en: Both brackets positive: the second pair is $+4y^{2}-2yz$, so after taking out $2y$ it must be $(2y-z)$.

traps.zh: $(x-2y)$ 這個符號配不出第一項 $+2xy$。
traps.en: $(x-2y)$ cannot reproduce the first term $+2xy$.

tip.zh: 四項題先問自己「哪兩項有同一個括號」，答案通常就在那個括號裡。
tip.en: With four terms, ask which two terms share a bracket — the answer usually sits in that bracket.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $x=2$, $y=3$, $z=5$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。
alt.en: Paper 2 rescue plan: put small numbers into the letters (for example $x=2$, $y=3$, $z=5$; avoid $0$ and $1$ because they make several options equal and useless), evaluate the question on your calculator, then substitute the same numbers into the four options — only one gives the same value, and that is the answer. It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m04.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q4 · [HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q4]

title.zh: 認題：四項，先調位再分組

steps.zh: 直接把首兩項一組會抽不出共同括號；把 $+2qr$ 調上前，令 $pq+2qr=q(p+2r)$ 與 $p^{2}+2pr=p(p+2r)$ 配成一對。
steps.en: Grouping the first two as written leads nowhere; move $+2qr$ forward so that $pq+2qr=q(p+2r)$ pairs with $p^{2}+2pr=p(p+2r)$.

steps.zh: 第一組抽 $q$、第二組抽 $p$，兩組都出現 $(p+2r)$。
steps.en: Take out $q$ from the first pair and $p$ from the second: both give $(p+2r)$.

steps.zh: 抽走 $(p+2r)$，剩下 $q-p$（次序是 $q$ 減 $p$，因為第二組前面是負號）。
steps.en: Take out $(p+2r)$; what is left is $q-p$ — the minus in front of the second pair makes the order $q$ minus $p$.

traps.zh: $(p-q)$ 的次序倒轉了：$-p(p+2r)$ 抽出來的是 $-p$，所以括號是 $(q-p)$。
traps.en: The order in $(p-q)$ is reversed: $-p(p+2r)$ contributes $-p$, so the bracket is $(q-p)$.

traps.zh: $(q-2r)$ 抽不出 $pq-2pr$（那組的公因式是 $p$，不是 $q$）。
traps.en: $(q-2r)$ cannot produce $pq-2pr$ — the common factor of that pair is $p$, not $q$.

traps.zh: 兩處都錯（次序與 $2r$ 的符號）：展開後會得到 $-2qr$。
traps.en: Both wrong (order and the sign of $2r$): expanding gives $-2qr$.

tip.zh: 分組失敗就調位：把「有共同括號」的兩項拉在一起，這是四項題的常規動作。
tip.en: If the grouping fails, rearrange: pull together the two terms that share a bracket.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $p=2$, $q=3$, $r=5$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。
alt.en: Paper 2 rescue plan: put small numbers into the letters (for example $p=2$, $q=3$, $r=5$; avoid $0$ and $1$ because they make several options equal and useless), evaluate the question on your calculator, then substitute the same numbers into the four options — only one gives the same value, and that is the answer. It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m05.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q5 · [HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q4]

steps.zh: 把 $+4xz$ 調上第二個位置：$6xy+4xz=2x(3y+2z)$。
steps.en: Move $+4xz$ into second place: $6xy+4xz=2x(3y+2z)$.

steps.zh: $-3y^{2}-2yz=-y(3y+2z)$：抽 $-y$ 會令括號內兩項同時變號，剛好與第一組相同。
steps.en: $-3y^{2}-2yz=-y(3y+2z)$: taking out $-y$ flips both signs inside, matching the first bracket exactly.
Take out $(3y+2z)$; what is left is $2x-y$.

traps.zh: $(3y-2z)$ 與第一組 $2x(3y+2z)$ 不符：$z$ 項的符號相反。
traps.en: $(3y-2z)$ does not match the first pair $2x(3y+2z)$: the sign of the $z$ term is opposite.

traps.zh: $(2x+y)$ 會令 $6xy$ 變成 $-6xy$（因為 $-y\cdot 3y=-3y^{2}$ 是對的，但 $+y$ 不對）。
traps.en: $(2x+y)$ turns $6xy$ into $-6xy$: the $-y$ factor is right for $-3y^{2}$, but $+y$ is not.

traps.zh: 兩個括號的符號都錯：$+y$ 與 $+2z$ 展開後 $xy$ 一項會變成 $-6xy$。
traps.en: Both brackets have the wrong sign: $+y$ with $+2z$ expands to $-6xy$.

tip.zh: 一組抽負公因式（$-y$）可以令兩個括號一致；不要怕負號。
tip.en: Taking out a negative common factor ($-y$) can make the two brackets match — do not fear the minus.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $x=2$, $y=3$, $z=5$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。

It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m06.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q6 · [HKDSE 2013 Paper 2 Q3]

title.zh: 認題：六項，試抽共同括號
title.en: Six terms: look for a shared bracket

steps.zh: 第一、二項抽 $r$、第三、四項抽 $-s$、第五、六項抽 $t$ —— 三個括號都是 $(p-q)$。
steps.en: $r$ from the first pair, $-s$ from the second, $t$ from the third — all three brackets are $(p-q)$.

title.en: Check the signs you took out

steps.zh: $-ps+qs=-s(p-q)$（抽 $-s$，括號內兩項都變號）；這一步是這題唯一易錯位。
steps.en: $-ps+qs=-s(p-q)$ — taking out $-s$ flips both signs inside. This is the only tricky step.

steps.zh: 把 $(p-q)$ 抽走，剩下的 $r$、$-s$、$+t$ 全部放進同一個括號。
steps.en: Take $(p-q)$ out and collect what remains ($r$, $-s$, $+t$) in one bracket.

traps.zh: $-s$ 被寫成 $+s$：$-ps+qs$ 抽 $-s$ 才是 $(p-q)$。
traps.en: $-s$ written as $+s$: $-ps+qs$ only gives $(p-q)$ if you take out $-s$.

traps.zh: $(p+q)$ 對不上：三組括號分別是 $r(p-q)$、$-s(p-q)$、$t(p-q)$，全部是 $p-q$。
traps.en: $(p+q)$ does not fit: the three brackets are $r(p-q)$, $-s(p-q)$ and $t(p-q)$ — all $p-q$.

traps.zh: 兩處符號都錯（$p+q$ 與 $+s$）：展開後 $qr$ 一項的符號會相反。
traps.en: Both signs wrong ($p+q$ and $+s$): expanding gives the opposite sign for the $qr$ term.

tip.zh: 項數多過四項照樣分組：三組、四組都可以，只要最後出現同一個括號。
tip.en: More than four terms still works: group into threes or fours as long as one bracket appears everywhere.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $p=2$, $q=3$, $r=5$, $s=7$, $t=11$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。

It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m07.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q7 · [HKDSE 2013 Paper 2 Q3]

steps.zh: 含 $a$ 的三項放前面、含 $b$ 的三項放後面：$a(x+y-z)-b(x+y-z)$。
steps.en: Put the three $a$-terms first and the three $b$-terms after: $a(x+y-z)-b(x+y-z)$.

steps.zh: 抽 $a$ 時 $+ax+ay-az=a(x+y-z)$；抽 $-b$ 時 $-bx-by+bz=-b(x+y-z)$（三項同時變號）。
steps.en: Taking out $a$: $+ax+ay-az=a(x+y-z)$. Taking out $-b$: $-bx-by+bz=-b(x+y-z)$ (all three signs flip).

steps.zh: 抽走 $(x+y-z)$，剩下 $a-b$。
steps.en: Take out $(x+y-z)$; what is left is $a-b$.

traps.zh: $(x-y+z)$ 的符號錯：原式是 $+ay$、$-az$，括號內應為 $x+y-z$。
traps.en: The signs in $(x-y+z)$ are wrong: the question has $+ay$ and $-az$, so the bracket is $x+y-z$.

traps.zh: $(a+b)$ 對不上：含 $b$ 的三項前面全部變號，抽出來是 $-b$。
traps.en: $(a+b)$ does not fit: the three $b$-terms all flip sign, so $-b$ comes out.

traps.zh: 兩處都錯（$a-b$ 配 $x-y+z$）：展開後 $ay$ 會變成 $-ay$。
traps.en: Both wrong ($a-b$ with $x-y+z$): expanding gives $-ay$ instead of $+ay$.

tip.zh: 首項是負號（$-bx$）時，把它連同 $b$ 一起抽成 $-b(\;)$，很多時兩個括號就會一模一樣。
tip.en: When the first term is negative ($-bx$), take it out as $-b(\;)$ together with $b$ — the two brackets often then match.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $a=2$, $b=3$, $x=5$, $y=7$, $z=11$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。

It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m08.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q8 · [HKDSE 2020 Paper 2 Q4]

steps.zh: 看似要展開重做，其實不用：$12x-9y=3(4x-3y)$，所以 $-x(12x-9y)=-3x(4x-3y)$，與前面那項共用 $(4x-3y)$。
steps.en: No need to expand: $12x-9y=3(4x-3y)$, so $-x(12x-9y)=-3x(4x-3y)$, which shares the bracket $(4x-3y)$ with the first term.

steps.zh: 兩項合併後是同一個括號乘以 $(2x+7y-3x)$。
steps.en: Both terms are the same bracket multiplied by $(2x+7y-3x)$.

steps.zh: $2x-3x=-x$，所以係數是 $-x+7y$。
steps.en: $2x-3x=-x$, so the bracket becomes $-x+7y$.

traps.zh: 括號內 $2x-3x$ 寫成 $5x$（應該相減，不是相加）。
traps.en: Writing $2x-3x$ as $5x$: the terms subtract, they do not add.

traps.zh: $(4x+3y)$ 不對：原式是 $4x-3y$，抽公因式不會改變它。
traps.en: $(4x+3y)$ is wrong: the original bracket $4x-3y$ does not change when you factor.

traps.zh: 兩處都錯（$+3y$ 與 $5x$）：展開後 $xy$ 一項會變成 $-35xy$。
traps.en: Both wrong ($+3y$ and $5x$): expanding gives $-35xy$ for the $xy$ term.

tip.zh: 看到 $(12x-9y)$ 就問一句：它是不是某個括號的倍數？$12x-9y=3(4x-3y)$ —— 這是卷二的常見陷阱。
tip.en: When you see $(12x-9y)$, ask whether it is a multiple of another bracket: $12x-9y=3(4x-3y)$. A classic Paper 2 trap.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $x=2$, $y=3$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。
alt.en: Paper 2 rescue plan: put small numbers into the letters (for example $x=2$, $y=3$; avoid $0$ and $1$ because they make several options equal and useless), evaluate the question on your calculator, then substitute the same numbers into the four options — only one gives the same value, and that is the answer. It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m09.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q9 · [HKDSE 2020 Paper 2 Q4]

steps.en: $10u-12v=2(5u-6v)$, so $3u(10u-12v)=6u(5u-6v)$, sharing the bracket $(5u-6v)$.

steps.zh: 第一個括號 $(7u-4v)$ 減去 $6u$。
steps.en: From the first bracket $(7u-4v)$ subtract $6u$.

steps.zh: $7u-6u=u$，所以係數是 $u-4v$。
steps.en: $7u-6u=u$, so the bracket is $u-4v$.

traps.zh: $(5u+6v)$ 不對：原式的括號是 $5u-6v$。
traps.en: $(5u+6v)$ is wrong: the original bracket is $5u-6v$.
Both wrong ($+6v$ and $13u$): $7u-6u=u$, not $13u$.

traps.zh: $13u$ 是把 $7u+6u$ 相加：題目是「減去 $6u(5u-6v)$」，所以要相減。
traps.en: $13u$ comes from adding $7u+6u$, but the question subtracts $6u(5u-6v)$, so the terms subtract.

tip.zh: 減號在括號前面，抽公因式後「整條括號」都要減 —— 卷二最常考這個位。
tip.en: With a minus in front, the whole bracket is subtracted — one of the most common Paper 2 traps.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m10.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q10 · [HKDSE 2016 Paper 2 Q3]

title.en: Recognise the difference of two squares

steps.en: $36=6^{2}$, so the whole expression has the form $a^{2}-b^{2}$ with $a=6$, $b=3x-2y$.

steps.zh: $b$ 是整條 $(3x-2y)$，所以要加括號：$6-b$ 與 $6+b$。
steps.en: $b$ is the whole bracket $(3x-2y)$, so keep it in brackets: $6-b$ and $6+b$.

steps.zh: $6-(3x-2y)=6-3x+2y$：括號前面是減號，$2y$ 要變號。
steps.en: $6-(3x-2y)=6-3x+2y$: the minus in front flips the sign of $2y$.

traps.en: $-2y$ was not flipped: $6-(3x-2y)$ is $6-3x+2y$.

traps.zh: 第二個括號寫成 $6+3x-2y$：$(a-b)$ 的 $b$ 本身就是 $3x-2y$，符號只變一次。
traps.en: The second bracket is written $6+3x-2y$: in $(a-b)$ the $b$ is already $3x-2y$, so the signs change only once.

traps.zh: 兩個括號的 $2y$ 符號都錯：應為 $+2y$ 配 $-2y$。
traps.en: The $2y$ signs are wrong in both brackets: they should be $+2y$ against $-2y$.

tip.zh: 平方差題：先把兩邊都寫成「某個整體」的平方（$36=6^{2}$），再套公式；括號千萬不要拆散。
tip.en: Difference of two squares: first write both parts as squares of a single object ($36=6^{2}$), then apply the identity — never split the bracket.

name.zh: 另解二：卷二 MC 專用數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.en: Put $x=1$, $y=1$: the expression is $36-(3-2)^{2}=35$; A gives $11$, B gives $7$, C gives $55$ and D gives $35$ — only D matches.

eph-ws01b-m11.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q11 · [HKDSE 2016 Paper 2 Q3]

title.en: Recognise the difference of two squares

steps.zh: $(a+b)(a-b)$，$b$ 保留括號。
steps.en: $(a+b)(a-b)$, keeping $b$ in its bracket.
$7-(4r-3s)=7-4r+3s$ (the $-3s$ becomes $+3s$); the second bracket just opens: $7+4r-3s$.

traps.en: $-3s$ was not flipped ($7-4r-3s$ should be $7-4r+3s$).

traps.zh: 第二個括號的 $-3s$ 加了括號卻沒有保持原樣：應為 $7+4r-3s$。
traps.en: The second bracket should read $7+4r-3s$; the $-3s$ keeps its sign.

traps.zh: 兩處都錯：把兩個括號的 $3s$ 都寫成加號。
traps.en: Both wrong: both brackets show $+3s$.

tip.zh: 「$\square-(\;)^{2}$」永遠是平方差；拆括號時只變「減法那一個」的符號。
tip.en: Anything of the form $\square-(\;)^{2}$ is a difference of two squares; only the subtracted bracket flips sign.

name.zh: 另解二：卷二 MC 專用數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.en: Put $r=1$, $s=1$: the expression is $49-(4-3)^{2}=48$; A gives $0$, B gives $0$, C gives $48$ and D gives $84$ — only C matches.

eph-ws01b-m12.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q12 · [HKDSE 2012 Paper 2 Q2]

title.en: Spot the difference of two squares

steps.en: With $a=3p+q$ and $b=3p-q$ this is $a^{2}-b^{2}$, so the identity is quickest.

steps.zh: 先寫成兩個括號相乘，才化簡。
steps.en: Write it as a product of two brackets first, then simplify.
$3p+q+3p-q=6p$ and $3p+q-3p+q=2q$; multiplying gives $12pq$.

traps.zh: 以為兩個平方相減等於 $0$：只有在 $a=b$ 時才成立。
traps.en: Thinking the squares cancel to $0$: that only happens when $a=b$.

traps.zh: $2q^{2}$ 是把 $2q$ 再乘一次自己；正確是 $6p\times 2q$。
traps.en: $2q^{2}$ squares $2q$; the correct step is $6p\times 2q$.

traps.zh: $6pq$ 只取了 $(a+b)$ 那部分，漏了 $\times 2q$。
traps.en: $6pq$ keeps only part of $(a+b)$ and misses the $\times 2q$.

tip.zh: 兩個平方相減，用平方差比展開快很多，而且不易錯符號。
tip.en: For a difference of two squares the identity beats expanding — faster and fewer sign slips.

name.zh: 另解一：直接完全展開相消（最穩做法）

alt.zh: 直接展開兩組完全平方：$(9p^{2}+6pq+q^{2})-(9p^{2}-6pq+q^{2})$。減號後面要整組變號：$9p^{2}+6pq+q^{2}-9p^{2}+6pq-q^{2}$；$9p^{2}$ 與 $q^{2}$ 互相抵消，剩下 $6pq+6pq=12pq$。搞不清公式中括號的正負號時，這條路最穩。
alt.en: Expand both squares directly: $(9p^{2}+6pq+q^{2})-(9p^{2}-6pq+q^{2})$. Everything after the minus changes sign: $9p^{2}+6pq+q^{2}-9p^{2}+6pq-q^{2}$. $9p^{2}$ and $q^{2}$ cancel, leaving $6pq+6pq=12pq$ — the safest route if the signs confuse you.

name.zh: 另解二：卷二 MC 專用數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.en: Put $p=1$, $q=2$: the expression is $(3+2)^{2}-(3-2)^{2}=25-1=24$; A gives $0$, B gives $8$, C gives $12$ and D gives $12(1)(2)=24$ — only D matches.

eph-ws01b-m13.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q13 · [HKDSE 2012 Paper 2 Q2]（選項 A 由 OCR 缺字重建，請覆核）

title.en: Spot the difference of two squares

steps.en: With $a=2a-5b$ and $b=2a+5b$, use $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$.

steps.zh: 第一個括號相加、第二個相減。
steps.en: Add in the first bracket, subtract in the second.

traps.zh: $-10ab$ 是只取了第二個括號 $-10b$ 的部分：還要乘 $4a$。
traps.en: $-10ab$ keeps only the $-10b$ from the second bracket; it still has to be multiplied by $4a$.

traps.zh: $-20ab$ 是把 $a$ 的係數當成 $2a$（正確是 $4a$）：$2a-5b+2a+5b=4a$。
traps.en: $-20ab$ uses $2a$ for the $a$-coefficient instead of $4a$: $2a-5b+2a+5b=4a$.
$-50b^{2}$ comes from mixing $(-5b)^{2}$ with $-(5b)^{2}$; the $b^{2}$ terms cancel in a difference of squares.

tip.zh: 先用公式化簡括號，最後才乘係數 —— 這樣就不會漏乘。
tip.en: Simplify the brackets with the identity first, multiply the coefficients last — nothing gets missed.

name.zh: 另解一：直接完全展開相消（最穩做法）

alt.en: Expand directly: $(4a^{2}-20ab+25b^{2})-(4a^{2}+20ab+25b^{2})$$=4a^{2}-20ab+25b^{2}-4a^{2}-20ab-25b^{2}=-40ab$. The $a^{2}$ and $b^{2}$ terms cancel and only the middle term survives.

name.zh: 另解二：卷二 MC 專用數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.en: Put $a=1$, $b=1$: the expression is $(2-5)^{2}-(2+5)^{2}=9-49=-40$; A gives $-10$, B gives $-20$, C gives $-40ab=-40$ and D gives $-50$ — only C matches.

eph-ws01b-m14.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q14 · [HKDSE 2017 Paper 2 Q1]

title.zh: 認題：前三項是二次三項式，先十字相乘
title.en: The first three terms are a quadratic: use the cross-method

steps.en: Factorize $x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$: the cross products give $(x)(2y)+(-y)(x)=2xy-xy=xy$ ✓

title.en: Look at the last two terms $+x-y$

steps.zh: $+x-y=+(x-y)$：就是 $(x-y)$ 這個括號本身。
steps.en: $+x-y=+(x-y)$, which is exactly the bracket $(x-y)$.
Take out $(x-y)$; what remains is $(x+2y)$ and $+1$.

traps.en: $(x-2y)$ does not fit: $x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}=(x-y)(x+2y)$ needs $+xy$ in the middle.

traps.zh: $(x+y)$ 會令首三項的中間項變成 $-xy$。
traps.en: $(x+y)$ would make the middle term $-xy$.

traps.zh: 兩處都錯（$x+y$ 與 $+2y-1$）：最後抽出來的「$+1$」應該是加號。
traps.en: Both wrong ($x+y$ and $+2y-1$): the $+1$ taken out must be positive.

tip.zh: 四項題：前三項做十字相乘，剩下的那兩項通常正好是「同一個括號」或它的倍數。
tip.en: For four terms: factorize the first three by the cross-method and the remaining two usually form that same bracket.

steps.en: The cross products $(x)(2y)+(-5y)(x)=2xy-5xy=-3xy$ ✓ matching the given $-3xy$.

title.en: Create a difference of two squares

steps.zh: 把後三項一齊加括號並在前面加負號：$-y^{2}+4y-4=-(y^{2}-4y+4)$。
steps.en: Bracket the last three terms with a minus in front: $-y^{2}+4y-4=-(y^{2}-4y+4)$.

title.en: The bracket is a perfect square

steps.zh: $a=x$、$b=y-2$；拆括號時只有「減那個」變號：$x-y+2$。
steps.en: With $a=x$ and $b=y-2$: only the subtracted bracket flips sign, giving $x-y+2$.

traps.zh: $-2$ 的符號錯：$x-(y-2)=x-y+2$，所以第一個括號是 $+2$。
traps.en: The sign of $2$ is wrong: $x-(y-2)=x-y+2$, so the first bracket has $+2$.

traps.zh: 兩處都錯（$-2$ 與 $+2$）：$x-(y-2)$ 只會變一次號。
traps.en: Both signs wrong ($-2$ and $+2$): $x-(y-2)$ flips the sign only once.

traps.zh: 第二個括號寫成 $x-y-2$：$x+(y-2)=x+y-2$，中間是加號。
traps.en: The second bracket reads $x-y-2$, but $x+(y-2)=x+y-2$ — the middle sign is plus.

tip.en: For $x^{2}-(\;)^{2}$, first create the square: the last three terms become $-(y-2)^{2}$.

title.en: Create a difference of two squares

steps.zh: 把最後三項一齊加括號並在前面加負號。
steps.en: Bracket the final three terms with a minus in front.

title.en: The bracket is a perfect square

steps.en: With $a=m$ and $b=3n+1$: $m-(3n+1)=m-3n-1$ — the minus applies to the whole bracket.

traps.zh: 兩個括號的常數項寫成 $+1$ 與 $-1$：應該相加的那邊是 $m+3n+1$。
traps.en: The constants are written $+1$ and $-1$ in the wrong brackets: the added one is $m+3n+1$.

traps.zh: 兩個括號都寫 $m-3n+1$：展開後會出現 $+9n^{2}$ 而不是 $-9n^{2}$。
traps.en: Both brackets read $m-3n+1$: expanding gives $+9n^{2}$, not $-9n^{2}$.

traps.zh: 完全平方的平方根是 $3n+1$（加號）：$m$ 與它相加、相減，不是兩邊都減。
traps.en: The square root is $3n+1$ (plus sign): $m$ is added to it once and subtracted once, not subtracted twice.

tip.zh: 「$\square-\triangle$」型的四項題：三項抽成一個平方，再用平方差；括號內的符號只變一次。
tip.en: For four-term questions of the shape $\square-\triangle$: make three terms into a square, then use the difference of two squares — the signs flip only once.

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $(x-y)$ —— 第二項其實是 $(x-y)$ 的 $1$ 倍。

steps.en: $-(3u+3v)=-3(u+v)$: the minus goes out together with $-3$.

traps.en: $(u-v)(u+v-3)$ swaps the two brackets: the square difference gives $(u+v)$ and the factored part is $(u-v)$.

tip.en: When a minus covers a whole pair ($-3u-3v$), factor out a negative: $-3(u+v)$ — then both terms match.

steps.en: $+a-b=+(a-b)$, exactly the bracket above.

traps.en: The sign of $1$ is wrong: $+a-b=+(a-b)$, so the constant term is $+1$.

tip.en: For four terms, rearrange first: put the two terms that form a difference of two squares together.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法（Substitution）

alt.zh: 卷二救急法：隨意代小的數入題目中的字母（例如 $a=2$, $b=3$；避開 $0$ 與 $1$，因為它們會令很多選項同時變成 $0$ 或相同值，分不出真假），用計算機算出題目的值；再把同一組數逐個代入四個選項，只有一個會得到相同的數值 —— 那就是答案。完全不懂分組都可以用，最適合用來核對或救急。
alt.en: Paper 2 rescue plan: put small numbers into the letters (for example $a=2$, $b=3$; avoid $0$ and $1$ because they make several options equal and useless), evaluate the question on your calculator, then substitute the same numbers into the four options — only one gives the same value, and that is the answer. It works even when you cannot see the grouping.

eph-ws01b-m25.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q25 · [HKDSE 2022 Paper 2 Q1]

title.en: Rearrange and use the difference of two squares

steps.zh: $-m+n=-(m-n)$：抽 $-1$ 出來才對得上。
steps.en: $-m+n=-(m-n)$: taking out $-1$ makes it match.
Take out $(m-n)$; what remains is $(m+n)$ and $-1$.

traps.en: The sign of $1$ is wrong: $-m+n=-(m-n)$, so it is $-1$.

traps.zh: $(m+n)$ 抽不出來：兩項都是 $(m-n)$ 的倍數。
traps.en: $(m+n)$ cannot be factored out: both terms are multiples of $(m-n)$.

traps.zh: $(m+n)(m-n-1)$ 只是把兩個括號對調了次序，展開後常數項符號會相反。
traps.en: $(m+n)(m-n-1)$ merely swaps the brackets, which flips the sign of the constant term.

tip.zh: 「$-m+n$」寫成 $-(m-n)$：一個負號，就令兩項對得上。
tip.en: Write $-m+n$ as $-(m-n)$ — one minus sign makes the two terms match.

eph-ws01b-m26.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q26 · [HKDSE 2018 Paper 2 Q3]

title.en: Rearrange and use the difference of two squares

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $(h-k)$。
steps.en: Both terms contain $(h-k)$.
Take out $(h-k)$; what remains is $(h+k)$ and $-4$.

traps.en: The sign of $4$ is wrong: $-4h+4k=-4(h-k)$, so it is $-4$.

traps.zh: $(h+k)$ 抽不出來：共同括號是 $(h-k)$。
traps.en: $(h+k)$ cannot be factored out: the shared bracket is $(h-k)$.

traps.zh: $(h+k)(h-k+4)$：$-4$ 的符號錯，而且兩個括號對調了。
traps.en: $(h+k)(h-k+4)$: the sign of $4$ is wrong and the brackets are swapped.

tip.zh: 負號包住兩項（$-4h+4k$）→ 抽 $-4$，令它變成前面那個括號。
tip.en: When a minus covers a pair ($-4h+4k$), take out $-4$ so that it becomes the earlier bracket.

eph-ws01b-m27.source: EPH WS01 DSE Paper 2 MC Q27 · [HKDSE 2018 Paper 2 Q3]

title.en: Rearrange and use the difference of two squares

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $(m+3n)$。
steps.en: Both terms contain $(m+3n)$.
Take out $(m+3n)$; what remains is $(m-3n)$ and $-2$.

traps.en: $(m-3n)$ cannot be factored out: $-2m-6n=-2(m+3n)$, so the shared bracket is $(m+3n)$.
The sign of $2$ is wrong: $-2m-6n=-2(m+3n)$, so it is $-2$.

traps.zh: 兩個括號都寫 $m+3n$：平方差提供的是 $(m-3n)$，不是兩個都加。
traps.en: Both brackets read $m+3n$, but the difference of two squares gives $(m-3n)$ for one of them.

tip.en: Rearrange to $(m^{2}-9n^{2})-(2m+6n)$, take out $-2$, then factor $(m+3n)$.

eph-ws01c-q01.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q1 [HKCEE 2009 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

title.en: Part (a): take out the common factor

steps.zh: 兩個單項的公因式是 $xy$（每個字母取最低次）。這一步的答案就是 (b) 的鎖匙。
steps.en: The common factor is $xy$ (take the lowest power of each letter). This answer is the key to part (b).

title.zh: (b) 搬 (a) 的答案，再配出同一個括號
title.en: Part (b): reuse (a) and create the same bracket

steps.zh: 把 (a) 的結果直接搬過來；餘下的 $+2x+6y$ 抽 $2$ 得 $2(x+3y)$，與 (a) 的括號一致。
steps.en: Copy the result of (a); the remaining $+2x+6y$ becomes $2(x+3y)$, matching the bracket from (a).

steps.zh: 抽走 $(x+3y)$，剩下 $xy+2$。
steps.en: Factor out $(x+3y)$; what remains is $xy+2$.

traps.label: (b) 逐項抽公因式就停手
traps.zh: 把六項各自抽完就當完成；題目要的是「一個乘積」，必須抽到出現共同括號為止。
traps.en: Factoring each term separately is not enough: the answer must be a single product, so keep going until one bracket appears twice.

traps.label: (a) 抽 $x^{2}y$
traps.zh: 公因式是 $xy$ 而不是 $x^{2}y$；抽錯會令括號內出現分數。
traps.en: The common factor is $xy$, not $x^{2}y$; taking out too much leaves fractions inside the bracket.

tip.zh: 卷一的 (b) 幾乎一定「藏著」與 (a) 相同的括號；(a) 做對，(b) 就是送分。
tip.en: In Paper 1, part (b) almost always hides the same bracket as (a): get (a) right and (b) is nearly free.

name.zh: 驗算法：展開對回原式（做完自己檢查）
name.en: Check: expand and compare with the question

alt.zh: 把答案展開，逐項對回原式：① (a)(b) 抽出的括號有沒有在 (c)／(b) 出現？② 最高次項係數對不對？③ 中間項（$mn$／$xy$ 那類）符號對不對？④ 常數項對不對？核對這四點，就算老師未改你都知自己對唔對。
alt.en: Expand your answer and compare term by term: (1) does the bracket found in (a) or (b) reappear? (2) is the leading coefficient right? (3) is the sign of the middle term ($mn$, $xy$, …) right? (4) is the constant term right? Check these four and you will know whether you are correct.

eph-ws01c-q02.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q2 （同型練習）（3 marks）

title.en: Part (a): take out the common factor

steps.zh: 係數取 H.C.F.（$2$），字母取最低次（$mn$），所以公因式是 $2mn$。
steps.en: Take the H.C.F. of the coefficients ($2$) and the lowest powers of the letters ($mn$), giving $2mn$.

steps.zh: 後兩項 $-m+2n=-(m-2n)$：負號要連 $-1$ 一起抽，括號才對得上 (a)。
steps.en: The last two terms give $-(m-2n)$: take out $-1$ as well so the bracket matches part (a).

steps.zh: 抽走 $(m-2n)$，剩下 $2mn-1$（那個 $-1$ 一定要寫，不可以消失）。
steps.en: Factor out $(m-2n)$; what remains is $2mn-1$ (the $-1$ must be written down).

traps.label: 後兩項抽 $+1$
traps.labelEn: Taking out $+1$ from the last two terms
traps.en: $-m+2n=-(m-2n)$, not $+(m-2n)$; the wrong sign gives $(m-2n)(2mn+1)$.

traps.label: 忘記寫 $-1$
traps.zh: 抽走括號後該位置是 $-1$，漏寫就等於少了一個因式。
traps.en: After factoring out the bracket the leftover is $-1$; dropping it loses a factor.

tip.zh: 後兩項「倒轉次序」（$-m+2n$）就抽 $-1$：$-(m-2n)$，這是卷一最常見的一步。
tip.en: When the last pair comes in reversed order ($-m+2n$), take out $-1$: $-(m-2n)$ — the most common move in Paper 1.

eph-ws01c-q03.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q3 [HKCEE 2006 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

title.zh: (a)(b) 兩部各自抽公因式／用平方差
title.en: Parts (a) and (b): factor each simple expression

steps.zh: (a) 兩項都有 $b$；(b) 是平方差 $2^{2}-a^{2}$。兩部的答案都是 (c) 的材料。
steps.en: (a) Both terms contain $b$; (b) is the difference of two squares $2^{2}-a^{2}$. Both answers feed into part (c).

title.zh: (c) 先分組，再用 (a)(b) 的答案

steps.zh: $4-a^{2}$ 用 (b) 的結果；$+2b-ab$ 用 (a) 的結果 $b(2-a)$（官方 marking：(c) 直接給 1A，分組那一步不另給分）。
steps.en: Use (b)'s result for $4-a^{2}$ and (a)'s result $b(2-a)$ for $+2b-ab$.

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $(2-a)$，抽走後剩下 $(2+a)$ 與 $b$。
steps.en: Both terms contain $(2-a)$; what remains is $(2+a)$ and $b$.

traps.label: (c) 由頭重做
traps.zh: (c) 的最快做法是搬 (a)(b) 的答案；重新展開會又慢又容易錯。
traps.en: The quick way is to reuse (a) and (b); expanding again is slow and error-prone.

traps.label: (a) 寫成 $b(a-2)$
traps.zh: $2b-ab=b(2-a)$：括號內次序不要倒轉，否則 (c) 就配不上。
traps.en: $2b-ab=b(2-a)$: keep the order inside the bracket or part (c) will not match.

tip.zh: 三部曲的題目：先做 (a)(b)，把兩個答案寫在旁邊，(c) 就會自己浮出來。
tip.en: In a three-part question, do (a) and (b) first and jot the answers down — part (c) then falls into place.

eph-ws01c-q04.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q4 （同型練習）（3 marks）

steps.en: (a) Take out $n$; (b) the difference of two squares $16m^{2}-9=(4m)^{2}-3^{2}$.

steps.zh: 把 (c) 分成兩組：前面用 (b)，後面用 (a)（注意後面要整體加負號再抽 $n$，官方 marking 這一步不另給分）。
steps.en: Split (c) into two groups: (b) for the front, (a) for the back (note the minus in front of the second group).
Factor out $(4m-3)$; what remains is $(4m+3)$ and $-n$.

traps.label: (c) 負號只加在第一項
traps.labelEn: (c) applying the minus to only one term
traps.zh: $-(4mn-3n)=-4mn+3n$：加括號後兩項都要變號。
traps.en: $-(4mn-3n)=-4mn+3n$: after inserting the bracket both signs flip.

traps.label: (b) 忘記平方差要寫兩次
traps.labelEn: (b) forgetting the bracket is a difference of squares
traps.en: $16m^{2}-9=(4m+3)(4m-3)$ — both brackets are needed for part (c) to work.

tip.zh: (c) 第一步永遠是「加括號」：把 $_ - (_)$ 寫出來，之後就是抽公因式。
tip.en: Part (c) always starts by inserting brackets: write it as $-(\;)$ and then factor.

eph-ws01c-q05.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q5 [HKCEE 2007 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

title.en: Part (b): use (a) to create a difference of two squares

steps.en: Substitute the result of (a): the expression becomes $a^{2}-b^{2}$ with $a=r+6$, $b=s$.

title.en: Apply the difference of two squares

steps.zh: $(a+b)(a-b)$：$a=r+6$ 要整條加括號。
steps.en: $(a+b)(a-b)$ — keep $a=r+6$ in its bracket.

traps.label: (b) 由頭十字相乘
traps.zh: (b) 只要用 (a) 的結果就能變成平方差；重新分解會浪費時間，而且通常做不出來（有兩個字母）。
traps.en: Part (b) only needs (a)'s result to become a difference of squares; starting again wastes time and usually fails.

traps.label: 平方差的 $b$ 忘了括號
traps.labelEn: Forgetting the bracket in the identity
traps.zh: $(r+6+s)(r+6-s)$：$a$ 是整條 $(r+6)$，不能寫成 $r+6+s$ 後又拆散。
traps.en: $(r+6+s)(r+6-s)$: $a$ is the whole bracket $(r+6)$, so keep it together.

tip.zh: 見到「完全平方 $-$ 平方」的形狀：先 (a) 再平方差，兩步就完。
tip.en: When you see 'perfect square $-$ square', do (a) then the difference of two squares — two moves.

eph-ws01c-q06.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q6 [HKCEE 2010 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

title.en: Part (b): take out the minus to create a difference of squares

steps.zh: 後面三項整體加括號並變號，再用 (a) 的結果：$-p^{2}-14pq-49q^{2}=-(p+7q)^{2}$。
steps.en: Bracket the last three terms with a minus and use (a): $-p^{2}-14pq-49q^{2}=-(p+7q)^{2}$.

title.en: Apply the difference of two squares

steps.zh: $a=2r$、$b=p+7q$；拆括號時只有「減的那個」變號：$2r-(p+7q)=2r-p-7q$。
steps.en: With $a=2r$, $b=p+7q$: only the subtracted bracket flips, $2r-(p+7q)=2r-p-7q$.

traps.label: 負號只加在第一項
traps.labelEn: Applying the minus to one term only
traps.en: $-p^{2}-14pq-49q^{2}=-(p^{2}+14pq+49q^{2})$: all three signs flip.

traps.label: (b) 把 $4r^{2}$ 也抽進負號
traps.zh: 只有「後三項」要變號，$4r^{2}$ 留在外面，否則做不出平方差。
traps.en: Only the last three terms flip sign; $4r^{2}$ stays outside, otherwise no difference of squares appears.

tip.zh: $-X-Y-Z$ 這類尾巴：整組抽 $-1$ 變成 $-(X+Y+Z)$，再用 (a)。
tip.en: For a tail like $-X-Y-Z$, factor out $-1$ to get $-(X+Y+Z)$ and then use (a).

eph-ws01c-q07.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q7 [HKDSE 2013 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

title.en: Part (b): use (a) and factor $3$ from the last two terms

steps.zh: $+9x+6y=+3(3x+2y)$：正是 (a) 其中一個括號。
steps.en: $+9x+6y=+3(3x+2y)$, which is one of (a)'s brackets.
Factor out $(3x+2y)$; what remains is $(3x-2y)$ and $+3$.

traps.label: 抽走 $(3x-2y)$
traps.zh: $+9x+6y=3(3x+2y)$，所以抽走的是 $(3x+2y)$；抽錯括號就對不上。
traps.en: $+9x+6y=3(3x+2y)$, so $(3x+2y)$ is the one to factor out.

traps.label: $+3$ 寫成 $-3$
traps.zh: $+9x+6y$ 是加，所以最後的常數項是 $+3$。
traps.en: $+9x+6y$ is positive, so the final constant is $+3$.

tip.zh: (a) 給兩個括號，(b) 一定選其中一個：把餘下兩項抽到能產生它。
tip.en: Part (a) gives two brackets; part (b) uses one of them — factor the remaining pair to produce it.

eph-ws01c-q08.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q8 （同型練習）（3 marks）

title.en: Part (b): take out $-4$ from the last two terms

steps.en: $-20r+16s=-4(5r-4s)$: taking out $-4$ matches $(5r-4s)$ from (a).
Factor out $(5r-4s)$; what remains is $(5r+4s)$ and $-4$.

traps.label: 抽 $+4$ 而不是 $-4$
traps.en: $-20r+16s=-4(5r-4s)$; taking out $+4$ gives $-(5r+4s)$, which does not match (a).

traps.label: $-4$ 漏寫
traps.zh: 抽走共同括號後剩下的 $-4$ 要寫在第二個括號內。
traps.en: The leftover $-4$ must appear in the second bracket.

tip.zh: (b) 的後兩項符號一正一負時，通常要抽「負公因式」；試 $-1$、$-2$、$-4$…看哪個能對上 (a)。
tip.en: When the last pair has mixed signs, try a negative common factor ($-1$, $-2$, $-4$…) until it matches (a).

eph-ws01c-q09.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q9 [HKDSE 2012 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

steps.en: $a^{2}-2(a)(4b)+(4b)^{2}$ ✓ — the middle minus makes the bracket minus.

title.en: Part (b): take out $5$ from the last two terms

steps.en: $+5a-20b=+5(a-4b)$, exactly (a)'s bracket.

steps.zh: 兩項都有 $(a-4b)$；抽走後剩下 $(a-4b)$ 與 $+5$。
steps.en: Both terms contain $(a-4b)$; what remains is $(a-4b)$ and $+5$.

traps.label: (b) 抽走括號後漏了那個 $(a-4b)$
traps.zh: 答案是 $(a-4b)(a-4b+5)$：$(a-4b)$ 出現兩次，不可以只寫一次。
traps.en: The answer is $(a-4b)(a-4b+5)$: the bracket appears twice and must be written twice.

tip.zh: (a) 是完全平方時，(b) 通常就是「同一條括號」再乘一個數字。
tip.en: When (a) is a perfect square, (b) is usually that same bracket multiplied by a number.

eph-ws01c-q10.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q10 （同型練習）（3 marks）

title.en: Part (b): take out $-4$ from the last two terms

steps.en: $-8x-12y=-4(2x+3y)$: taking out $-4$ matches (a).
Factor out $(2x+3y)$; what remains is $(2x+3y)$ and $-4$.

traps.label: (b) 抽 $+4$
traps.en: $-8x-12y=-4(2x+3y)$; taking out $+4$ gives $-(2x+3y)$, which does not match.

traps.label: (a) 交叉項當成 $6xy$
traps.zh: $12xy=2(2x)(3y)$：交叉項是 $2ab$ 的形式，要乘 2。
traps.en: $12xy=2(2x)(3y)$: the middle term has the form $2ab$ — don't forget the 2.

tip.zh: 完全平方的三個數：首平方、末平方、中間是「$2	imes$ 首 $	imes$ 末」。
tip.en: Perfect square: first squared, last squared, middle is $2\times$ first $\times$ last.

eph-ws01c-q11.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q11 [HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q2]（3 marks）

title.zh: (a) 十字相乘（寫成 $a^{2}+5a+6$ 較易看）

steps.zh: 習慣上把 $a$ 的次數由高至低排好：$a^{2}+5a+6$，再十字相乘。
steps.en: Rearrange in descending powers: $a^{2}+5a+6$, then use the cross-method.

title.en: Part (b): take out $b^{2}$ from the last two terms

steps.en: $+3b^{2}+ab^{2}=+b^{2}(3+a)$, one of (a)'s brackets.
Factor out $(3+a)$; what remains is $(2+a)$ and $b^{2}$.

traps.label: (a) 次序寫成 $(a+2)(a+3)$ 就當不同
traps.zh: $(2+a)(3+a)$ 與 $(a+2)(a+3)$ 是同一個數；但 (b) 要對上的是官方寫法 $(3+a)$。
traps.en: $(2+a)(3+a)$ and $(a+2)(a+3)$ are the same product, but part (b) must match the bracket you used in (a).

traps.label: (b) 漏寫 $(2+a)$
traps.zh: 抽走 $(3+a)$ 之後，$(2+a)$ 與 $b^{2}$ 都要寫進同一個括號。
traps.en: After factoring out $(3+a)$, both $(2+a)$ and $b^{2}$ belong in the same bracket.

tip.zh: (b) 多出一個字母（$b$）時，先抽它的次方，就會看到 (a) 的括號。
tip.en: When (b) brings in a new letter ($b$), factor out its power and (a)'s bracket appears.

eph-ws01c-q12.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q12 （同型練習）（3 marks）

steps.en: Cross products $(2m)(1)+(-3)(m)=2m-3m=-m$ ✓
The first two terms give $2n^{2}(m+1)$; the last three terms are exactly (a).
Both terms contain $(m+1)$; what remains is $2n^{2}$ and $(2m-3)$.

traps.label: (b) 找不到要用 (a)
traps.zh: (b) 的三項 $+2m^{2}-m-3$ 就是 (a) 的原式，換成 $(2m-3)(m+1)$ 才做得下去。
traps.en: The last three terms of (b) are exactly (a); replace them with $(2m-3)(m+1)$ to continue.

traps.label: 把 $(2m-3)$ 也抽走
traps.zh: 只有 $(m+1)$ 是兩項共同的括號，$(2m-3)$ 只在一項出現。
traps.en: Only $(m+1)$ is common to both terms; $(2m-3)$ appears just once.

tip.zh: (b) 部「分散」時，先看哪幾項可以併回 (a) 的原式，這是最快的入手點。
tip.en: When (b) looks scattered, find the terms that recombine into (a)'s expression — that is the entry point.

eph-ws01c-q13.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q13 [HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q3, 2021 Paper 1 Q3]（3 marks）

steps.zh: 交叉相乘 $(a)(2b)+(b)(a)=3ab$ ✓
steps.en: Cross products $(a)(2b)+(b)(a)=3ab$ ✓

title.en: Part (b): take out $9$ from the last two terms

steps.en: $+9a+18b=+9(a+2b)$, exactly (a)'s bracket.
Factor out $(a+2b)$; what remains is $(a+b)$ and $9$.

traps.label: 抽走 $(a+b)$
traps.en: $+9a+18b=9(a+2b)$, so the shared bracket is $(a+2b)$.

traps.label: (b) 把 $9$ 留在括號外不寫
traps.zh: 完成後應為 $(a+2b)(a+b+9)$：$9$ 是第二個括號的一項。
traps.en: The answer is $(a+2b)(a+b+9)$: the $9$ is a term of the second bracket.

tip.zh: 這一題是 2017 與 2021 兩年的卷一真題：套路完全一樣。
tip.en: This question appeared in both 2017 and 2021: the routine is identical.

eph-ws01c-q14.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q14 （同型練習）（3 marks）

steps.en: Cross products $(3m)(-3n)+(-2n)(2m)=-9mn-4mn=-13mn$ ✓

title.en: Part (b): take out the minus, then use (a)

steps.zh: 後三項整組抽負號後就是 (a)；$9m-6n=3(3m-2n)$ 又與 (a) 的 $(3m-2n)$ 相同。
steps.en: Taking a minus out of the last three terms gives (a); and $9m-6n=3(3m-2n)$ matches (a)'s bracket.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 抽走共同括號，中括號內逐項分配負號
title.en: Step 3 · Factor the common bracket out and distribute the minus inside the square brackets

steps.zh: 抽走 $(3m-2n)$ 之後，餘下部分先用中括號整組包住：$[3-(2m-3n)]$。減號必須逐項分配：$-(+2m)=-2m$、$-(-3n)=+3n$，化簡得 $(3m-2n)(3-2m+3n)$。這一格最忌心算跳步 —— 直接寫就會變成 $3-2m-3n$（第二項漏了變號），一分就飛走。
steps.en: After factoring out $(3m-2n)$, keep the remainder inside square brackets: $[3-(2m-3n)]$. Distribute the minus to every term: $-(+2m)=-2m$ and $-(-3n)=+3n$, giving $(3m-2n)(3-2m+3n)$. Never do this step in your head: the classic slip is $3-2m-3n$, which loses the last mark.

traps.label: 負號忘記分配
traps.en: $-(6m^{2}-13mn+6n^{2})=-6m^{2}+13mn-6n^{2}$: all three signs flip.

traps.label: 最後的 $-2m+3n$ 寫成 $2m-3n$
traps.labelEn: Sign error in the last bracket
traps.zh: 抽走 $(3m-2n)$ 之後剩下的那項是 $-(2m-3n)$，要保留負號。
traps.en: After factoring out $(3m-2n)$ what remains is $-(2m-3n)$; keep the minus.

tip.zh: (b) 的首兩項若「順序倒轉」（$9m-6n$），先抽一個數，再看能否與 (a) 的括號對上。
tip.en: If (b) starts with a reversed pair ($9m-6n$), factor it and check whether it matches (a)'s bracket.

eph-ws01c-q15.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q15 [HKDSE 2020 Paper 1 Q2]（3 marks）

steps.en: Cross products $(a)(-3)+(4)(a)=-3a+4a=a$ ✓

steps.zh: 三項最低次都是 $a^{2}$，抽走它之後括號內就是 (a) 的原式。
steps.en: Every term has at least $a^{2}$; taking it out leaves exactly (a)'s expression.

steps.zh: 括號內用 (a) 的結果：$a^{2}(a+4)(a-3)$，三個因式相乘。
steps.en: Replace the bracket with (a)'s result: $a^{2}(a+4)(a-3)$ — three factors.

traps.label: (b) 只抽 $a$
traps.zh: 抽 $a^{2}$ 才會令括號內變回 (a) 的原式；抽 $a$ 會剩下 $a^{2}+a-12$ 以外的東西。
traps.en: Taking out $a^{2}$ reproduces (a); taking out $a$ leaves a different bracket.

traps.label: (b) 抽完就停手
traps.zh: 抽 $a^{2}$ 只是第一步，括號內仍要分解成 $(a+4)(a-3)$（題目要求 completely）。
traps.en: Factoring $a^{2}$ is only step one; the bracket must still become $(a+4)(a-3)$.

tip.zh: 高次題（$a^{4}$、$a^{3}$）的固定做法：先抽最低次，讓括號內變回 (a)。
tip.en: Higher-degree questions ($a^{4}$, $a^{3}$): factor out the lowest power so the bracket becomes (a).

eph-ws01c-q16.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q16 （同型練習）（3 marks）

steps.en: Cross products $(2a)(3)+(-5)(a)=6a-5a=a$ ✓

steps.zh: 三項最低次是 $a^{2}$；抽走後括號內就是 (a)。
steps.en: Every term has at least $a^{2}$; the bracket then becomes (a).

steps.zh: 答案要寫成三個因式相乘：$a^{2}(2a-5)(a+3)$。
steps.en: The answer is a product of three factors: $a^{2}(2a-5)(a+3)$.

traps.label: (b) 抽 $a$
traps.zh: 抽 $a^{2}$ 才能還原 (a)；抽 $a$ 括號內會變成 $2a^{3}+a^{2}-15a$，仍要再抽。
traps.en: Only $a^{2}$ restores (a); taking out $a$ leaves $2a^{3}+a^{2}-15a$, needing another step.

traps.label: 答案漏掉 $a^{2}$
traps.zh: 抽走的 $a^{2}$ 是其中一個因式，漏寫就等於少了一個因子。
traps.en: The $a^{2}$ you factored out is a factor of the answer — never drop it.

tip.zh: 抽公因式 → 括號內用 (a) → 寫成乘積，這三步對所有高次題都合用。
tip.en: Factor out, use (a) inside the bracket, write the product — this routine covers every higher-degree question.

eph-ws01c-q17.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q17 （同型練習）（3 marks）

steps.en: Cross products $(3b)(-3)+(2)(2b)=-9b+4b=-5b$ ✓

title.en: Part (b): take out $-b^{2}$ (minus and lowest power)

steps.zh: 最高次是 $-6b^{4}$（負），所以抽 $-b^{2}$；這樣括號內就變回 (a) 的原式。
steps.en: The highest-degree term is $-6b^{4}$ (negative), so take out $-b^{2}$; the bracket becomes exactly (a).

steps.zh: 括號內用 (a) 的答案，最後寫成三個因式相乘。
steps.en: Replace the bracket with (a)'s answer — three factors in the final product.

traps.label: (b) 抽 $b^{2}$
traps.zh: 抽 $b^{2}$ 會得到 $b^{2}(6-5b-6b^{2})$，符號全部相反，之後無法直接代入 (a)。
traps.en: Taking out $b^{2}$ gives $b^{2}(6-5b-6b^{2})$, whose signs are all reversed — (a) cannot be substituted.

traps.label: (b) 抽完就停手
traps.zh: 抽 $-b^{2}$ 只是第一步，括號內仍要用 (a) 分解到 $(3b+2)(2b-3)$。
traps.en: Factoring $-b^{2}$ is only the first step; the bracket still has to become $(3b+2)(2b-3)$.

tip.zh: 高次項而首項係數是負的：抽 $-x^{2}$ 連負號一起走，括號內就會變回 (a)。
tip.en: When the highest-degree coefficient is negative, take out $-x^{2}$ with the minus so the bracket becomes (a).
