eph-ws01c-q18.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q18 [HKDSE 2015 Paper 1 Q4]（4 marks）

steps.zh: 三項最低次都是 $x^{2}$，抽走後括號內是 $(x+y+5)$。
steps.en: Each term has at least $x^{2}$; the bracket becomes $(x+y+5)$.

title.zh: (b) 後三項＝(a) 括號的負數
title.en: Part (b): the last three terms are minus (a)'s bracket

steps.zh: $-x-y-5=-(x+y+5)$：正是 (a) 括號的負數，可以直接抽走。
steps.en: $-x-y-5=-(x+y+5)$: exactly minus (a)'s bracket, so it can be factored out straight away.

steps.zh: 抽走之後餘下 $x^{2}-1$，仍可用平方差分解 —— 題目要求 completely，一定要做這一步。
steps.en: What remains is $x^{2}-1$, which still factorizes by the difference of two squares — required for 'completely'.

traps.label: 忘記再分解 $x^{2}-1$
traps.zh: 卷一的「completely」是要分到最後一刻：$x^{2}-1=(x-1)(x+1)$，少寫就失一分。
traps.en: 'Completely' means factor to the very end: $x^{2}-1=(x-1)(x+1)$ — omitting it loses a mark.

traps.label: 負號只加在一項
traps.labelEn: Applying the minus to one term only
traps.zh: $-x-y-5=-(x+y+5)$：三項都要變號，否則對不上 (a)。
traps.en: $-x-y-5=-(x+y+5)$: all three signs flip, otherwise it will not match (a).

tip.en: The standard ending for a six-term question: factor out (a)'s bracket, leaving $x^{2}-1$, $x^{2}-9$, $x^{2}-16$… then use the difference of two squares.

eph-ws01c-q19.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q19 （同型練習）（4 marks）

steps.zh: 三項最低次是 $a^{2}$；括號內 $(a+3b-4)$ 就是 (b) 的鎖匙。
steps.en: Every term has at least $a^{2}$; the bracket $(a+3b-4)$ is the key to part (b).

title.en: Part (b): the last three terms are the negative
Take out, then difference of squares

steps.en: $a^{2}-1=(a-1)(a+1)$ — three factors in the answer.

traps.label: 漏寫 $(a+3b-4)$ 的第二個括號
traps.zh: 答案是 $(a-1)(a+1)(a+3b-4)$：$(a+3b-4)$ 只出現一次，但不可以漏。
traps.en: The answer is $(a-1)(a+1)(a+3b-4)$: the bracket $(a+3b-4)$ appears once and must not be dropped.

traps.label: $a^{2}-1$ 不分解
traps.zh: 題目要求 completely，$a^{2}-1$ 必須再分。
traps.en: The question says 'completely', so $a^{2}-1$ must be factorized further.

tip.en: After factoring $x^{2}$ the remainder is usually $x^{2}-1$, which is always $(x-1)(x+1)$.

eph-ws01c-q20.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q20 （同型練習）（4 marks）

steps.zh: 三項最低次是 $x^{2}$。
steps.en: Every term has at least $x^{2}$.

title.en: Part (b): take out $-9$ from the last three terms

steps.en: $-9x+9y-18=-9(x-y+2)$, matching (a)'s bracket exactly.

title.en: Take out, then difference of squares

traps.label: 後三項抽 $+9$
traps.labelEn: Taking out $+9$ from the last three terms
traps.en: $-9x+9y-18=-9(x-y+2)$; taking out $+9$ gives $-(x-y+2)$, an extra minus.

traps.label: $x^{2}-9$ 不分解
traps.en: $x^{2}-9$ is a difference of two squares and must become $(x-3)(x+3)$.

tip.zh: 抽公因式時「負數一起抽」：$-9$ 比 $+9$ 更容易令括號對上 (a)。
tip.en: Take the negative with the factor: $-9$ makes the bracket match (a), $+9$ does not.

eph-ws01c-q21.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q21 [HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q5]（4 marks）

steps.zh: 兩項最低次是 $m^{2}$。
steps.en: Both terms have at least $m^{2}$.

title.en: Part (b): take out $-n^{2}$ from the last two terms

steps.en: $-mn^{2}-3n^{3}=-n^{2}(m+3n)$, the same bracket as (a).

title.en: Take out, then difference of squares

traps.label: $m^{2}-n^{2}$ 不分解
traps.en: $m^{2}-n^{2}=(m-n)(m+n)$ — factor to the end.

tip.zh: 六項／四項題的收尾都一樣：抽走共同括號之後，餘下的多半是平方差。
tip.en: Four- and six-term questions end the same way: after factoring out the shared bracket, what remains is usually a difference of two squares.

eph-ws01c-q22.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q22 （同型練習）（4 marks）

steps.zh: 係數取 H.C.F. $4$、字母取 $x^{2}$。
steps.en: Take the H.C.F. $4$ of the coefficients and $x^{2}$ for the letters.

title.en: Part (b): take out $-y^{2}$ from the last two terms
Take out, then difference of squares

traps.label: $4x^{2}-y^{2}$ 不分解
traps.en: It is a difference of two squares: $(2x-y)(2x+y)$; stopping earlier loses a mark.

traps.label: 後兩項抽 $-y$
traps.zh: 抽 $-y$ 會留下 $y(x-5y)$，括號次序雖然對，但會多一個 $y$ 在外面，不如抽 $-y^{2}$ 乾淨。
traps.en: Taking out $-y$ leaves an extra $y$ outside; $-y^{2}$ is the cleaner choice.

tip.zh: 係數有 H.C.F.（4）時，先抽數字再抽字母，最後一步才用平方差。
tip.en: When the coefficients share an H.C.F. (4), factor numbers first, letters second, and save the difference of squares for last.

eph-ws01c-q23.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q23 （同型練習）（4 marks）

steps.zh: 兩項的公因式是 $4s^{2}$。
steps.en: The common factor is $4s^{2}$.

title.en: Part (b): take out $9r^{2}$ from the first two terms

steps.en: $18r^{3}-9r^{2}s=9r^{2}(2r-s)$, matching (a)'s bracket.

title.en: Take out, then difference of squares

traps.label: 選錯共同括號
traps.en: (a)'s bracket is $(2r-s)$; both pairs in (b) must produce it.

traps.label: $9r^{2}-4s^{2}$ 不分解
traps.zh: 係數 $9$ 與 $4$ 都是平方數，所以仍可分成 $(3r-2s)(3r+2s)$。
traps.en: Both $9$ and $4$ are squares, so it still splits into $(3r-2s)(3r+2s)$.

tip.zh: (b) 的兩組各自抽公因式時，目標只有一個：令兩個括號變成一樣。
tip.en: When factoring both pairs in (b), aim at one thing only: make the two brackets identical.

eph-ws01c-q24.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q24 [HKDSE 2016 Paper 1 Q4]（4 marks）

steps.en: (a) factor $3$; (b) cross-method: $(m)(-4n)+(5n)(m)=mn$ ✓ Both contain $(m-4n)$.

steps.zh: 後面 $-3m+12n=-3(m-4n)$，與 (b) 的括號一致。
steps.en: The tail $-3m+12n=-3(m-4n)$ matches (b)'s bracket.

steps.zh: 抽走後剩下 $(m+5n)$ 與 $-3$。
steps.en: What remains after factoring is $(m+5n)$ and $-3$.

traps.label: (c) 忘記用 (b) 的結果
traps.zh: (c) 的三項 $m^{2}+mn-20n^{2}$ 就是 (b)，換成 $(m+5n)(m-4n)$ 才做得下去。
traps.en: The first three terms of (c) are exactly (b); replace them with $(m+5n)(m-4n)$ to continue.

traps.label: 抽走錯的括號
traps.en: $-3m+12n=-3(m-4n)$, so the shared bracket is $(m-4n)$, not $(m+5n)$.

tip.zh: 三部曲的 (c)：一半用 (a) 或 (b) 的括號，另一半是它們的倍數 —— 找出來就通了。
tip.en: In part (c) of a three-part question, one half supplies the bracket and the other half is a multiple of it.

steps.en: (b) cross-method: $(x)(-3y)+(-2y)(x)=-3xy-2xy=-5xy$ ✓

steps.zh: $-6x+18y=-6(x-3y)$，與 (b) 其中一個括號相同。
steps.en: $-6x+18y=-6(x-3y)$, matching one of (b)'s brackets.
Factor out $(x-3y)$; what remains is $(x-2y)$ and $-6$.

traps.label: (c) 抽走 $(x-2y)$
traps.en: $-6x+18y=-6(x-3y)$, so the shared bracket is $(x-3y)$.

traps.label: (a) 抽 $6$ 之後次序倒轉
traps.zh: $6x-18y=6(x-3y)$：次序要與 (b)(c) 一致，方便之後配對。
traps.en: $6x-18y=6(x-3y)$: keep the order consistent with (b) and (c).

tip.zh: (a)(b) 做完先圈起「相同的括號」，那個就是 (c) 要抽走的東西。
tip.en: After (a) and (b), circle the identical bracket — that is what part (c) factors out.

steps.en: (b) cross-method: $(2a)(b)+(-5b)(a)=-3ab$ ✓ Both contain $(2a-5b)$.

title.en: Part (c): take out the minus, then substitute

steps.zh: $-(2a^{2}-3ab-5b^{2})$：後三項全體變號，(b) 的答案直接可用。
steps.en: $-(2a^{2}-3ab-5b^{2})$: the last three terms flip sign, so (b)'s answer can be used directly.

steps.zh: 抽走後剩下 $2$ 與 $-(a+b)$，即 $2-a-b$。
steps.en: What remains is $2$ and $-(a+b)$, i.e. $2-a-b$.

traps.label: 負號忘記分配
traps.en: $-(2a^{2}-3ab-5b^{2})=-2a^{2}+3ab+5b^{2}$: all three signs flip.

traps.label: 最後的 $-a-b$ 寫成 $+a+b$
traps.zh: 抽走 $(2a-5b)$ 之後剩下的那項是 $-(a+b)$，要保留負號：$2-a-b$。
traps.en: The term left over is $-(a+b)$; keep the minus: $2-a-b$.

tip.zh: (c) 的次數倒轉（先兩次、後三次）時，通常要「整組抽負號」再代入。
tip.en: When (c) lists the lower-degree pair first, take a minus out of the whole group and then substitute.

steps.en: (b) factor $n$ first; inside, $2m^{2}+11m-6=(2m-1)(m+6)$ (cross products $-m+12m=11m$ ✓).

title.en: Part (c): take out the minus, then substitute

steps.en: Use (b)'s answer for $-(2m^{2}n+11mn-6n)$; both (a) and (b) contain $(2m-1)$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 抽走 $(2m-1)$，再把括號內的乘積展開
title.en: Step 3 · Factor out $(2m-1)$, then expand the product inside the bracket

steps.zh: 抽走共同括號 $(2m-1)$ 之後，中括號內留下 $[(2m+1)-n(m+6)]$。把 $-n$ 乘進去：$-n(m)=-mn$、$-n(+6)=-6n$（兩個都要變號），得 $2m+1-mn-6n$；最後按字母整理成 $2m-mn-6n+1$。答案內不可以留著未展開的括號乘積 —— 官方 marking 的最後一分就是這一步。
steps.en: After factoring out $(2m-1)$, the square bracket holds $[(2m+1)-n(m+6)]$. Multiply $-n$ in: $-n(m)=-mn$ and $-n(6)=-6n$ (both terms change sign), giving $2m+1-mn-6n$, then tidy it as $2m-mn-6n+1$. Never leave an unexpanded product inside a factor — the final mark depends on it.

traps.label: (c) 只抽 $(2m-1)$ 卻沒有展開 $-n(m+6)$
traps.zh: 答案的第二個括號要化簡成 $2m-mn-6n+1$，不可留有未展開的乘積。
traps.en: The second bracket must be simplified to $2m-mn-6n+1$; no products may be left unexpanded.

traps.label: (b) 抽 $n$ 之後只寫 $(2m^{2}+11m-6)$
traps.zh: 括號內仍要十字相乘成 $(2m-1)(m+6)$，否則 (c) 用不到。
traps.en: The bracket must still factorize to $(2m-1)(m+6)$, otherwise (c) cannot use it.

tip.zh: 三部曲抽走共同括號之後，括號內若有「$-n(…)$」這種乘積，要展開化簡才完成。
tip.en: After factoring the shared bracket out, any product such as $-n(\ldots)$ left inside must be expanded and simplified.

steps.en: (b) factor $s$; inside, $3r^{2}-11r-20=(3r+4)(r-5)$ (cross products $-15r+4r=-11r$ ✓).

title.en: Part (c): take out the minus, then substitute

steps.zh: 兩部都藏著 $(3r+4)$。
steps.en: Both parts contain the bracket $(3r+4)$.

steps.zh: 展開 $-s(r-5)=-rs+5s$，再合併同類項。
steps.en: Expand $-s(r-5)=-rs+5s$ and collect like terms.

traps.label: (c) 未展開 $-s(r-5)$
traps.zh: 第二個括號要化簡成 $3r-rs+5s-4$。
traps.en: The second bracket must simplify to $3r-rs+5s-4$.

traps.label: (b) 漏寫 $s$
traps.zh: $s$ 是 (b) 抽出的因式，答案要寫 $s(3r+4)(r-5)$。
traps.en: The $s$ factored out must stay: $s(3r+4)(r-5)$.

tip.zh: (b) 抽出的字母（$s$）不可漏；抽走共同括號後，括號內再化簡。
tip.en: Never drop the letter factored out in (b); after taking the shared bracket out, simplify inside.

steps.en: (b) factor $x$; inside, $10y^{2}+17y+6=(5y+6)(2y+1)$ (cross products $5y+12y=17y$ ✓).

title.en: Part (c): take out the minus, then substitute

steps.zh: 留意 $(6+5y)$ 與 $(5y+6)$ 是同一個括號（加法交換律）。
steps.en: Note that $(6+5y)$ and $(5y+6)$ are the same bracket (addition is commutative).
Expand $-x(2y+1)=-2xy-x$.

traps.label: 認不出 $(6+5y)=(5y+6)$
traps.zh: 加法可以交換，兩個寫法是同一個括號，所以 (c) 可以直接抽走它。
traps.en: Addition is commutative, so both writings are the same bracket and (c) can factor it out.

traps.label: (c) 未展開 $-x(2y+1)$
traps.zh: 第二個括號要寫成 $6-5y-2xy-x$。
traps.en: The second bracket must read $6-5y-2xy-x$.

tip.zh: 遇到 $(a+b)$ 與 $(b+a)$ 時，記住它們相等；這是很多學生看不出的「已經配對」。
tip.en: Remember $(a+b)=(b+a)$: many students miss that the brackets already match.

title.en: Part (b): take the minus out of the last three terms and use (a)

steps.en: The whole expression becomes $a^{2}-b^{2}$ with $a=10c-d$ and $b=9c-1$.

title.en: Apply the difference of two squares and simplify

steps.en: $10c-d-(9c-1)=10c-d-9c+1=c-d+1$: distribute the minus to both terms.

traps.label: 拆括號時漏掉 $+1$
traps.zh: $-(9c-1)=-9c+1$：括號前面是減號，兩項都要變號。
traps.en: $-(9c-1)=-9c+1$: with a minus in front, both terms change sign.

traps.label: (b) 由頭展開
traps.zh: 把 $(10c-d)^{2}$ 展開再重做非常費時；用 (a) 造成平方差兩步就完。
traps.en: Expanding $(10c-d)^{2}$ wastes time; using (a) to form a difference of squares takes two moves.

tip.zh: 卷一最後一兩年的「平方 − 平方」題：先 (a) 做完全平方，再整條套平方差。
tip.en: For the recent 'square $-$ square' questions: do the perfect square in (a), then apply the identity to the whole expression.

name.zh: 另解：常數項與符號保底檢查法
name.en: Alternative: check the constant term to confirm the signs

alt.zh: 不用重做，只看「純 $d$ 與常數」的部分就可以確認符號：原式的 $-81c^{2}+18c-1$ 與 $(10c-d)^{2}$ 中的 $-d$ 部分，對應 $(-d)^{2}-1=d^{2}-1$；而答案 $(19c-d-1)(c-d+1)$ 中，把 $c$ 視為 $0$ 得 $(-d-1)(-d+1)=d^{2}-1$ ✓ 完全相符，證明正負號全部都對。這是卷一最後檢查答案最快的方法。
alt.en: No need to redo the question: check only the terms in $d$ and the constant. The question contributes $(-d)^{2}-1=d^{2}-1$; in the answer $(19c-d-1)(c-d+1)$, putting $c=0$ gives $(-d-1)(-d+1)=d^{2}-1$ ✓ — identical, so every sign is right. The quickest final check in Paper 1.

steps.zh: 後面三項整組抽負號之後就是 (a)。

traps.label: 拆括號符號錯

eph-ws01c-q32.source: EPH WS01 · DSE Paper 1 題型 Q32 （同型練習）（4 marks）

title.en: Part (b): create a difference of two squares and apply it

steps.zh: 後面三項抽負號後就是 (a)。
steps.en: Taking the minus out of the last three terms gives (a).

title.zh: 拆括號、化簡、再抽公因式
title.en: Remove brackets, simplify, then factor again

steps.zh: 最後一步是官方 marking 的關鍵：$(10x+5y-5)$ 三項還有公因式 $5$，抽走才是 completely。
steps.en: The final move is the key to the official marking: $(10x+5y-5)$ still has a common factor $5$; take it out for 'completely'.

traps.label: 最後沒有抽 $5$
traps.zh: $(10x+5y-5)=5(2x+y-1)$：這一分是官方 marking 的一部分，很容易漏。
traps.en: $(10x+5y-5)=5(2x+y-1)$: this mark is part of the official marking and is easily missed.

traps.label: 拆括號符號錯
traps.en: $-(4x-5)=-4x+5$, so the second bracket is $6x+5y-4x+5=2x+5y+5$.

tip.zh: 做完平方差，記得檢查每個括號能否再抽公因式 —— 「completely」包括這一層。
tip.en: After the difference of two squares, check every bracket for a remaining common factor — 'completely' includes this.
